epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤獨內向的阿振在工作中飽受同事殘酷欺淩,絕望中他試圖透過網路尋找理想伴侶來救贖心靈。當一位與他夢中情人如出一轍的神秘女子米娜出現後,阿振以為迎來了真愛,不料一連串驚悚詭異的怪事卻接連發生,將他拖入無底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bullied by his coworkers, the lonely Ah Zhen turns to the internet in search of his ideal girl. However, when Mina, the woman of his dreams, suddenly enters his life, a series of unexpected events begins to unfold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 建築師May與男友Gun搬入新居後,驟聞繼母離奇身亡。May收留孤苦的繼妹Noon,怎料她入宅後竟行為詭異,頻遭惡靈附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象與嚴重失眠的折磨。隨著宅內黑暗秘密逐步揭開,通靈法師終於..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個不斷以自己的標準審判別人的司機,總是用自己的方式默默為他人著想,試圖救贖一個又一個在他眼中的“受害者。當他心儀的女性朋友似被其兒子利用,他不惜擅行私刑,漸漸成為冷血的連環殺手…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東瀛武士挑戰武林盟主袁增,戰敗後切腹自盡。忍者之王劍淵率領忍者渡海復仇,並佈下威力驚人的「五遁忍術」奇陣。袁增門下高手不諳忍術詭計,貿然迎戰竟全軍覆沒。倖存弟子潛心鑽研五遁之法,誓要以其人之道還治其人之身,破陣雪恥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a Japanese samurai is defeated and commits seppuku, ninja lord Chin leads his clan to China for revenge. They challenge martial arts leader Yuan with the deadly Five Elements Ninja Formation, wiping out his unprepared disciples. The survivors

epg.programme_title_en: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 化學教師陳子風在一間保守的女校任教,與青梅竹馬的李海倫共事。陳在醫務所拾得棄嬰,後把棄嬰帶到學校照顧,卻被學生謠傳嬰孩乃陳與李之私生子。陳不但輕鬆面對,還將朝氣帶入校園,大受學生歡迎,李亦漸漸愛上陳。但保守派對陳之作風不滿,侍機剷除陳。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls’ high school, is stuck with a baby that isn’t his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鐵中棠是大旗門掌門人雲翼的義子。門派宿敵司徒笑為奪取秘藏,追殺鐵中棠與雲翼次子雲錚。鐵中棠得知,唯有前往長春島尋找武功蓋世的「日后」,才能揭開大旗門的秘密。然而抵達後卻發現「日后」早已身亡,反而遇見大旗門創始人「夜帝」鐵毅,並驚覺對方竟是自己的親生父親。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tie Zhong Tang, adopted son of Da Chi Men leader Yun Yi, is hunted by rival Situ Xiao, who seeks the clans hidden treasure. To uncover its secrets, Tie journeys to Changchun Island to find the legendary Ri Hou. Instead, he finds Ri Hou dead and

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張生、崔鶯鶯才子佳人相會,俏紅娘從中牽赤繩;西廂夜訪,私定終身;崔老夫人知情大怒,憤而拷紅;紅娘怨夫人不該言而無信,終成就百年姻緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family’s objection, s

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 百毒派銳意製造武林不和,以實現稱霸江湖的野心。他們派出蒙面刺客殺戮另一門派,但其中一名刺客被捕後即被其他門派公審。最後審訊結果是什麼?最終又能否揭開真相?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they u

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武則天有傾國之貌,絕世才華,十四歲時更被唐太宗召為才人,但太宗死後卻入寺為尼,卻又與繼位之唐高宗有染,生有二子。時皇后與蕭妃爭寵,命武則天回宮以制妃子,卻反陷害皇后。武則天獲封皇后之後,更誅殺兩太子。直到高宗病亡,武后臨朝,成為史上第一個女皇帝。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大俠張七郎退隱江湖多年,他的妻兒及朋友卻被鬼頭黨所殺。悲憤的七郎打算獨力與鬼王決一生死,為他們報仇雪恨!惡名昭彰的鬼頭黨最終會被他打敗嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gang’s leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末年政局腐敗,社會民不聊生,慈禧太后與一群愚昧無知的權貴大臣不但毫無抵禦外國列強侵佔,以及保護人民的能力,反而迷信以吞符唸咒,自稱無堅不摧的「義和團」可以抵禦洋人,決意向列強宣戰。結果導致八國聯軍攻陷北京,慈禧太后倉惶逃難;人民這才醒悟到,只有孫中山先生領導的革命运動,才是挽救中國的唯一希望。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers’ claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching gove

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名強盜和一位居無定所的賭徒合作以賭賺錢。一天,他們成功從叛國軍閥屋裡偷取一大筆金錢,途中卻遇上革命戰士,並希望他們能資助革命叛軍計劃。二人是否會用偷來的財富協助革命戰士?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord’s home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄龍劇中為一準新郎,但卻遇上心術不正的恬妮單戀癡纏,更借助邪術降頭,務求奪取男方歡心。後恬妮裙下之臣羅烈及狄龍未婚妻,亦相繼加入戰團。一場因為愛而生與死的鬥爭,複雜的關係加上正邪大鬥法,將人性為達一己私慾的惡行,表露無遺。至於邪是否不能勝正?且看結局便有分曉。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancée Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wangs friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述,警局偵緝部情侶探員鄭忠與王麗芬同往離島露營,半夜麗芬忽聞異聲,離營探看,突見綠光一閃,隨即著魔。翌日,王警官率眾處理一宗挾持人質案件,期間麗芬逕自開槍射殺劫匪,過程被雜誌記者阿古攝得,發現子彈竟能轉向殺人...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May ins

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 據說諸魔化成的血鸚鵡,看見它的人能得到三個願望。江湖俠盜葉停楓為追尋血鸚鵡的真相;與名捕「鐵手無情」鐵恨聯手。某夜,葉、鐵二人在墳場遇上血鸚鵡,鐵死於它的魔力之下;後葉將其屍體送回家鄉安葬。其後,屍體卻離奇失蹤,葉經歷重重險阻後,終於見到真正的血鸚鵡…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個故事洋溢著《羅密歐與茱麗葉》般的悲戀色彩。兩個世代積怨已深的家族,被一條遍佈鱷魚的河流阻隔,誰也不願築橋往來。然而,命運卻讓兩家子女在大學裡邂逅並深深相愛。為了相守,他們不僅必須跨越險惡的河流,更要化解兩個家族間延續多年的仇恨。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 經營鏢局的大刀王五遇上譚嗣同,這位新黨成員致力於改革清末政府。雖然皇帝支持推行新法,但慈禧太后卻無意交出政權,因此她下令捉拿新黨的所有成員。儘管王五並無政治立場,卻無奈地被捲入這場政治漩渦之中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Emp

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一個耳熟能詳之中國民間神話故事,講述書生劉彥昌巧遇落入凡間的聖母三娘,二人一見鍾情,結下一段仙凡姻緣。但因與二郎神結怨,屢遭迫害,二郎神更將聖母壓在華山底下。彥昌與聖母之子沉香長大後,聞悉生母被壓華山,悲憤欲絕,藉神斧之助挫敗二郎神,劈山救母。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Lindas tragic suicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝兩位太子為要爭奪帝位,令人民死傷無數。被牽連在這場皇室鬥爭當中的女刺客,最終能否及時執行刺殺任務以助其中一位皇子登上皇位?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the t

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesnt care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dup

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祝英台女扮男裝入學堂求學,並與同窗梁山伯結下至死不渝的深情厚愛。山伯得知英台真實身份後,立即前往祝家提親,豈料英台早已被許配他人,二人被迫含淚分離。山伯因悲痛過度,一病不起,最終含恨離世。英台驚聞噩耗,悲痛欲絕,哭祭山伯墳前,更縱身躍入墓中,以身殉情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo di

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕女劍客服下奶奶研製的隱身藥後,變成白天隱形晚上現身的怪人。她無意中搗亂了黑道首領女兒的婚事,惹來連番追殺。女劍客最後如何脫險?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandma’s pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chief’s daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

epg.programme_title_en: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆為體察民情,撇下侍衛假扮商人微服出訪江南,期間得知衙門有貪官欺壓百姓,導致民不聊生。這時乾隆遇上一名清廉的賣菜青年,二人合力教訓貪官一頓。最後,青年更被獲封為皇帝的近身侍衛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people’s livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more tha

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述張愛珠無意得知自己是孤兒,故往找生母。生母茱莉與流氓劉老四同居,老四心起歪念,竟欲非禮愛珠,茱莉救了女兒,卻被老四誤殺。愛珠逃回養父母家,始深深體會到養父母對她的愛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is th

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of woman warriors and a group of ruthless bandits. The maverick teams up with the woman warriors to battle the bandits seeking to raid the emperor’s tomb.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A corrupt official attempts to steal a priceless Buddha statue from a temple to please a group of Westerners. Luckily, Doctor Zhang and his son manage to defeat the Western boxers, the Japanese Kendo opponents and the Western longsword fighters with

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu’s until her long lost mother appears

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Ming’s overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Enco

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword an

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆皇帝微服出巡,希望藉此了解百姓的生活需要,但卻碰上連串的奇遇,乾隆更被衙差關進牢獄,差點要被斬首…最後又有誰可拯救皇帝出困境?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien; Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop (Sun Chien) who helps him adjust to

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述千金小姐劉月英與丫鬟春蘭同遊花田盛會,邂逅橋邊畫畫的落拓書生卞濟。春蘭眼見小姐芳心暗許,於是穿針引線,欲促成良緣,卻因老家僕錯認小霸王周通為卞濟,使小姐與卞濟情路波折重重。在經過一連串誤會與錯配後,結局乃皆大歡喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant’s confusion, threatening the couple’s union.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與老夫子一起經歷連串的漫畫故事,看他和他傻頭傻腦的好友大番薯如何為抱得美人歸而弄至笑話連篇!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大理國王子段譽不懂武功,卻私自離宮闖蕩江湖。途中,段譽先後遇上玩蛇姑娘鍾靈和同父異母的姊姊木婉清。因緣際會下,段譽吸光朱蝮蟒的血和吃下碧血蛤,得到了絕世功力,最終更擊敗父親的多年仇敵黃袍人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobra’s bl

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事源自膾炙人口的《啼笑因緣》,內容描述民國初年,富家子范嘉恕戀上歌女岑逢仙,同時又唯賣藝少女官繡珠及貌似岑的財政廳長女兒賀莉霞所迷戀。張大帥垂涎岑,更姦污了她。嘉恕後得繡珠相助,才從大帥手中救回愛人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General’s henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水兒原是大太子之私生女,流落青樓 ,二太子欲利用水兒揭大太子醜行以謀皇位。大太子不惜派殺手暗殺水兒,而二太子則命燕十三、練飛霞等護送水兒回宮。兩批人沿途激戰,水兒得武士相救避禍隱居荒村,然二人性格迥異經常引起衝突。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperors daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美麗但無知的李天珍被外星人捉上飛碟,事後無人相信她曾與外星人接觸。於是,當她打算一死以示清白之際,卻遇上同有輕生念頭的失敗私家偵探伊電。二人互吐心聲後改變主意,卻遭遇一連串奇遇,而二人的愛情故事也因此開始。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern – an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一班不打不相識之眾,聚集在一起以保護愛國將軍免被加害。他們充當將軍的護送人員,前往危險的遠方英國領事館,途中遭到敵人和日軍的陰險干擾。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the general’s escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanes

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers help a family of Asian House Shrews overcome obstacles in their path to escape predator.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: There is an insect on Zari’s plant that looks like an alien.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers come across an animal that can separate its tail from its body to escape predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 臭鼩一家要逃離一隻飢餓的掠食者,少年遊俠沿途幫助牠們克服障礙。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers help a family of Asian House Shrews overcome obstacles in their path to escape predator.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #13
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #13
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利的植物上有一隻看似外星人的昆蟲。少年遊俠必須把牠帶到安全的地方,免牠在脫殼後受傷。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There is an insect on Zari’s plant that looks like an alien.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #14
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #14
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠在森林裡發現了一隻沒有鹿角的小鹿。出於安全考量,遊俠嘗試保護牠不受傷害。不過,他們很快就發現牠還有其他手段自保。留意觀看它們到底是甚麼!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers spot a small dear in the forest without any antlers.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #15
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #15
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利發現一隻小鳥被困樹上,而牠的同伴卻不見蹤影。少年遊俠兵分兩路執行任務:一組留下來從掠食者手中保護樹上的小鳥,另一組則去搜救失蹤同伴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari discovers a bird trapped in a tree and its partner is nowhere to be found.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #16
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #16
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠遇到一種可以在逃避掠食者時將尾巴與身體分離的動物。但他們必須從肥皂災難中把牠拯救出來免牠受傷。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers come across an animal that can separate its tail from its body to escape predators.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #17
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #17
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠發現一隻可愛的海洋動物嬰兒在海中游蕩。要讓牠與母親團聚實在很有挑戰性,尤其嬰兒不斷因其他動物和隨機物件而分心。他們能成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers find a cute baby sea animal wandering the ocean.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #18
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #18
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠的任務是讓黃蜂遠離蜂巢。姬蒂有一個新設備可以提供幫助……前題是她能使它正常運作。他們能成功完成任務嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers are on a mission to keep hornets away from a beehive.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #19
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #19
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這裡有松鼠,那裡有松鼠,到處都有松鼠!少年遊俠必須阻止松鼠入侵薩利鄰近的社區花園。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers must stop a squirrel invasion at Zari’s neighbourhood community garden.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #20
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #20
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 里奧和姬蒂把他們的小工具借給薩利,但卻被一群頑皮的猴子截劫。在沒有任何小工具幫助他們完成任務的情況下,遊俠將如何奪回他們的小工具呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leo and Katie loan out their gadgets to Zari, but they get stolen by a bunch of mischievous monkeys.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠薩利意外地在膠杯中發現了一隻獨特的昆蟲,他呼召遊俠團協助這隻可憐的生物安全回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Zari calls for the Rangers in helping a unique insect get back to safety.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉偶然發現一雙被困在井裡的母獅和她的幼獅。在遊俠的幫助下,他們需要想方設法來幫牠們擺脫困境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farah stumbles upon a trapped lioness and her cub inside a well.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉發現一顆未知的動物牙齒,並尋求遊俠團協助將其歸還給真正的主人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farah finds an unknown animal tooth and seeks the Rangers assistance in returning it to its rightful owner.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪遇到一隻正在掙扎的被困海豚!他尋求少年遊俠團協助海豚重獲自由。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kyle comes across a struggling trapped dolphin!

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利和法拉築篝火過夜時偶遇一隻馬來亞幼虎,於是呼召少年遊俠團助牠與母親團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stumbling a Malayan Tiger cub during their campfire sleepover.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱憐憫受傷的螃蟹,他呼召少年遊俠團幫助這隻可憐的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai calls for the Junior Rangers in helping the injured crab.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場意外令凱的無人機墜入海床。他知道一頭不知名的怪物劫持了那墜落的無人機後,就呼召少年遊俠團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai calls up the Junior Ranger as he learns a obscure monster is taken his fallen drone as hostage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利發現一隻可能瀕臨絕種的黃胸織布鳥,這讓少年遊俠團們警戒起來,迅速動員採取行動,決心保護這鳥類免受傷害。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers determined to safeguard the Baya Weaver bird from harm.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #9
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪並不知道與斧頭鯊共泳有多險象橫生,少年遊俠團隊用新升級的車輛極速去營救嘉豪。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers rush their way to rescue Kyle from hammerhead sharks with their newly upgraded vehicle.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita tries her own experiments in Mina’s lab. She’ll soon discover she first needs to learn some basics in order to avoid a disaster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠為一隻甘氏巨螯蟹發明了一條新的機械腿。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers invent a new mechanical leg for a Japanese Spider Crab.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 淘氣的日本獼猴偷走了小遊俠的裝備,原本的溫泉輕鬆之旅變成一場災難。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What was supposed to be a relaxing trip to the hot spring turns into a disaster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女王去度假,留給國王很多職務。他立即採取行動,找其他人來做。莉塔肯幫助國王……如果她能成為啫堡的女王!起初,所有孩子都很高興自己有份負責。不過,很快樂趣和遊戲就被只有莉塔開心的遊戲所取代。小女王必須意識到這種權力是如何沖昏她的頭腦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen goes on vacation, leaving King with lots of responsibilities. He leaps into action, finding someone else to do it. Rita will help the King...if she’s made Queen of Jammbo! At first, all the kids are happy one of their own is in charge. But,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們圍坐在篝火旁講恐怖故事。姑毛講述了最可怕的怪物故事,然後去吃點心。不過,他走得太遠!其他人必須在黑暗的樹林裡尋找他!神秘的影子和聲音很快讓他們都以為有怪物在跟蹤他們!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids are sitting around a campfire telling scary stories. Goomo tells the scariest monster story and then goes off to get a snack. But, he’s gone too long! The others must look for him in the dark woods! Before long mysterious shadow and sounds h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫喱星頌揚音樂、樂趣和友誼。加入貝洛和他的朋友們的喜劇冒險之旅,學習在神奇的詹博星球(宇宙音樂的起源)上和諧相處。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello makes a mistake and decides to make up a story, which is hard to believe. Mina gets angry and will put him to the test: the Candy of Truth. A sweet that makes you float every time you lie. Bello accepts the challenge and a spiral of lies and da

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜嘗試打造啫堡史上最驚人的韆鞦來取悅國王。不幸的是,這位年輕的科學家很快就發現,無論多麼先進的技術,都無法取締團隊合作和友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina tries to please the King by building the most amazing swing in the history of Jammbo. Unfortunately, the young scientist will soon discover that no matter how advanced technology is, it will never substitute teamwork and friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路被委派一項非常重要的工作—負責管理音樂工廠!儘管女王留下了說明書,比路卻無視它。她一去休息,整個運作就變得瘋狂。可憐的渡渡鳥努力把事情做好,但欠缺知情的老闆,災難迫在眉睫。比路必須快速學習,準備工作是正確執行任何工作的關鍵!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is given a very important job---he’s put in charge of running the Music Factory! Though the Queen leaves the instruction manual, Bello ignores it. As soon as she goes off for a much needed rest, the whole operation goes way crazy. The poor dodo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔厭倦了她玩的每場比賽都輸掉,所以她用一些小氣的手鐲來助她必勝。儘管一開始她很開心,但卻發現自己掉進一個危險的陷阱,並將使她成為一個失敗者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita is tired of losing at every game she plays so she allies herself with some stingy bracelets that will help her win at absolutely everything. Even though she is happy at first, Rita discovers that she’s fallen into a dangerous trap, which will ma

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡有麻煩了!它那奇妙的音樂泡泡充滿了垃圾和黏糊糊的東西。經過調查整個星球,國王、王后和孩子們意識到泡泡裡的垃圾正是他們的垃圾!他們齊心協力改變邋遢的習慣,讓啫堡恢復啫喱般的健康。他們在過程中將垃圾回收成大家都能享用的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jammbo’s in trouble! Its amazing music bubbles are full of trash and gunky goo. After a planet wide investigation, the King, Queen and kids realize that the junk in the bubbles is their own garbage! They work together to change their sloppy habits an

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多得一些突破性的科學,米娜能夠讓物體和她自己隱形!她看到隱形對她信任的朋友的影響!經過一天的瘋狂事件後,孩子們發現了所有看不見的怪事的罪魁禍首。他們想出一個自己的實驗,看看科學家有多喜歡接受測試!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thanks to some breakthrough science, Mina is able to make objects, and herself, invisible! She can’t help but see the effects of invisibility on her unsuspecting friends! After a day of wild happenings the kids discover the culprit of all the invisib

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡從未經歷過最驚人的事件之一即將發生。姑毛不想錯過它。這就是為何他嘗試向他的朋友隱瞞他的啫喱疹。不幸的是,啫喱疹有無法掩飾的症狀。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most amazing events that Jammbo has ever experienced is about to occur. And Goomo doesn’t want tomiss it. That’s why he tries to hide his Jelly-Measles from his friends. Unfortunately, the measles have symptoms that are impossible to disgu

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 受到閃電和雷聲的驚嚇,比路和姑毛在音樂工廠尋求庇護。不過進去以後,他們才意識到將迎接更可怕的事;城堡裡有個幽靈嚇壞了渡渡鳥,阻止牠們製造音樂泡泡!如果渡渡鳥停下來,啫堡就沒有音樂。而如果沒有音樂,啫喱星就會凍結!哎呀!男孩們需要找到幽靈,擊潰它並拯救永遠充滿音樂氣息的啫堡!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spooked by lighting and thunder, Bello and Goomo seek refuge in the Music Factory. But once inside, they realize there’s much scarier stuff afoot; there’s a ghost in the castle that’s frightening the dodos and keeping them from making music bubbles!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王不想與人分享他的新火箭驅動滑板,所以把它藏在一個魔法盒子裡。姑毛和比路決定取得它,挑戰國王的意願,最終進入一個更大的新世界。一個充滿樂趣和……危險的世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King doesn’t want to share his new rocket powered skateboard so he hides it in a magic box. Goomo and Bello decide to claim it, challenging the King’s wishes, and end up in a new and larger world. A world of fun and….danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇后心情不好。國王和孩子們同意舉辦有史以來最好的生日派對。不幸的是,每個參與者對於如何組織女王的驚喜派對都有個別非常特別的想法。它的成功將取決於他們「易地而處」的能力。尤其是女王。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen feels gloomy. The King and the children agree to organize the best birthday party ever. Unfortunately each of the participants has a very particular idea as to how to organize the Queen’s surprise party. Its success will depend on their cap

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路厭倦了女王,他認為女王試圖毀掉他所有的冒險和遊戲。在滿天流星的星夜,比路許下一個願望:願女王變回少女,讓他為所欲為。當比路的願望成真,他將必須當個瘋狂的小女王哥哥,並意識到這可能是很艱鉅的任務,有時甚至很危險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is fed up with the Queen, whom he thinks tries to ruin all his adventures and games. On a starry night, full of shooting stars, Bello makes a wish: may the Queen become a young girl again so she can let him do anything he wants. When Bello’s wi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是姑毛的生日,他有很高期望。不幸的是,他醒來發現珍愛的頭盔不見了!最重要的是,他的朋友們表現得很奇怪,他們似乎都忘記了他的生日。姑毛很樂意讓一切恢復正常。幸運的是,他收到一個驚喜,可以讓這天成為一個非常特別的日子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its Goomos birthday and his hopes are high. Unfortunately, he wakes to find his precious helmet missing! On top of that his friends are acting strangely and they all appear to have forgotten all about his birthday. Goomo would be happy to have thin

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安高在與比路和姑毛玩耍時弄傷了自己,因此必須在家休息幾天。比路感到內疚,決定搬進安高的房子,直到他的朋友好轉為止。他們對生活的不同看法相交,然後一起發現如果睜大眼睛看一切,即使是最小的細節,也可以很享受。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ongo hurt himself while playing with Bello and Goomo so he must stay at home to rest for several days. Bello feels guilty and decides to move into Ongo’s house until his friend feels better. Their different views on life will meet and together they’l

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔在米娜的實驗室試做自己的實驗。她很快就發現首先需要學習一些基礎知識來避免災難發生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita tries her own experiments in Mina’s lab. She’ll soon discover she first needs to learn some basics in order to avoid a disaster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水花帶牠的朋友去看探望朋友阿Lu/ 章魚浪花喜歡礁鎮的樂韻。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Splash takes his pals to go see his friend, LU / Wave, the octopus, loves the musicality of Reeftown.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水花被一條牠想交朋友的魚忽視/ 七彩麒麟芬尼加入一起玩。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Splash is ignored by a fish he wants to make friends with / Finny, a green dragonet, joins the group to play.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水花、寶泡和阿燈遇到自封為森林遊俠的奇普/ 寶泡的鰭受傷並無法游泳。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Splash, Bubbles, and Dunk meet a self-appointed Kelp Forest Ranger / Bubbles injures her fin and has trouble swimming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿燈的朋友發現他製作美麗的沙畫/ 阿波帶領同伴調查海龍的傳說。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dunks friends discover he makes beautiful sand art / Ripple leads the gang to investigate the legend of the Sea Dragon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們和外星人一起在太空舞蹈大賽中比「舞」!誰能獲得全宇宙最佳舞者的殊榮?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children compete in a space dance competition with aliens!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 炎熱的天氣把大花園裡的水都曬乾了。小孩們必須幫助他們的朋友找到水源,並拯救大花園免於消亡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The hot weather has dried up all the water in the Big Garden.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添想玩迷你籃球,但其他小孩都不想玩那遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim wants to play mini basketball, but none of the other children want to play that game.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利不熱衷參加其他小孩想玩的一些嘉年華遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy is not keen on taking part in some of the carnival games the other children want to play.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅鬍子船長偷走了寶拉和她的朋友們製作的紙扇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Redbeard steals the paper fans that Paula and her friends made.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們很難準時參加圖騰頭先生的生日驚喜派對。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children struggle to be on time for Mr. Totemheads surprise birthday party.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們興奮地去看龍先生的噴火表演。他們能及時趕到嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children are excited to watch Mr. Dragons fire-breathing show. Can they get there in time?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅鬍子船長病了,但他不想承認。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Redbeard is sick, but he doesnt want to admit it.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers come across a crocodile that is having the worst of days.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #12
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #12

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers help a family of Asian House Shrews overcome obstacles in their path to escape predator.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #13
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #13

epg.episode_synopsis_en: There is an insect on Zari’s plant that looks like an alien.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dragon finds out that learning a new language is like a secret password into another world./ When Shimmer’s friend, Cookie, loses her butterfly instincts, Miss Spider and her bug clan must help her regain them before winter arrives in Sunny Patch.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女王去度假,留給國王很多職務。他立即採取行動,找其他人來做。莉塔肯幫助國王……如果她能成為啫堡的女王!起初,所有孩子都很高興自己有份負責。不過,很快樂趣和遊戲就被只有莉塔開心的遊戲所取代。小女王必須意識到這種權力是如何沖昏她的頭腦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen goes on vacation, leaving King with lots of responsibilities. He leaps into action, finding someone else to do it. Rita will help the King...if she’s made Queen of Jammbo! At first, all the kids are happy one of their own is in charge. But,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們圍坐在篝火旁講恐怖故事。姑毛講述了最可怕的怪物故事,然後去吃點心。不過,他走得太遠!其他人必須在黑暗的樹林裡尋找他!神秘的影子和聲音很快讓他們都以為有怪物在跟蹤他們!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids are sitting around a campfire telling scary stories. Goomo tells the scariest monster story and then goes off to get a snack. But, he’s gone too long! The others must look for him in the dark woods! Before long mysterious shadow and sounds h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫喱星頌揚音樂、樂趣和友誼。加入貝洛和他的朋友們的喜劇冒險之旅,學習在神奇的詹博星球(宇宙音樂的起源)上和諧相處。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello makes a mistake and decides to make up a story, which is hard to believe. Mina gets angry and will put him to the test: the Candy of Truth. A sweet that makes you float every time you lie. Bello accepts the challenge and a spiral of lies and da

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜嘗試打造啫堡史上最驚人的韆鞦來取悅國王。不幸的是,這位年輕的科學家很快就發現,無論多麼先進的技術,都無法取締團隊合作和友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina tries to please the King by building the most amazing swing in the history of Jammbo. Unfortunately, the young scientist will soon discover that no matter how advanced technology is, it will never substitute teamwork and friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路被委派一項非常重要的工作—負責管理音樂工廠!儘管女王留下了說明書,比路卻無視它。她一去休息,整個運作就變得瘋狂。可憐的渡渡鳥努力把事情做好,但欠缺知情的老闆,災難迫在眉睫。比路必須快速學習,準備工作是正確執行任何工作的關鍵!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is given a very important job---he’s put in charge of running the Music Factory! Though the Queen leaves the instruction manual, Bello ignores it. As soon as she goes off for a much needed rest, the whole operation goes way crazy. The poor dodo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔厭倦了她玩的每場比賽都輸掉,所以她用一些小氣的手鐲來助她必勝。儘管一開始她很開心,但卻發現自己掉進一個危險的陷阱,並將使她成為一個失敗者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita is tired of losing at every game she plays so she allies herself with some stingy bracelets that will help her win at absolutely everything. Even though she is happy at first, Rita discovers that she’s fallen into a dangerous trap, which will ma

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡有麻煩了!它那奇妙的音樂泡泡充滿了垃圾和黏糊糊的東西。經過調查整個星球,國王、王后和孩子們意識到泡泡裡的垃圾正是他們的垃圾!他們齊心協力改變邋遢的習慣,讓啫堡恢復啫喱般的健康。他們在過程中將垃圾回收成大家都能享用的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jammbo’s in trouble! Its amazing music bubbles are full of trash and gunky goo. After a planet wide investigation, the King, Queen and kids realize that the junk in the bubbles is their own garbage! They work together to change their sloppy habits an

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多得一些突破性的科學,米娜能夠讓物體和她自己隱形!她看到隱形對她信任的朋友的影響!經過一天的瘋狂事件後,孩子們發現了所有看不見的怪事的罪魁禍首。他們想出一個自己的實驗,看看科學家有多喜歡接受測試!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thanks to some breakthrough science, Mina is able to make objects, and herself, invisible! She can’t help but see the effects of invisibility on her unsuspecting friends! After a day of wild happenings the kids discover the culprit of all the invisib

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡從未經歷過最驚人的事件之一即將發生。姑毛不想錯過它。這就是為何他嘗試向他的朋友隱瞞他的啫喱疹。不幸的是,啫喱疹有無法掩飾的症狀。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most amazing events that Jammbo has ever experienced is about to occur. And Goomo doesn’t want tomiss it. That’s why he tries to hide his Jelly-Measles from his friends. Unfortunately, the measles have symptoms that are impossible to disgu

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 受到閃電和雷聲的驚嚇,比路和姑毛在音樂工廠尋求庇護。不過進去以後,他們才意識到將迎接更可怕的事;城堡裡有個幽靈嚇壞了渡渡鳥,阻止牠們製造音樂泡泡!如果渡渡鳥停下來,啫堡就沒有音樂。而如果沒有音樂,啫喱星就會凍結!哎呀!男孩們需要找到幽靈,擊潰它並拯救永遠充滿音樂氣息的啫堡!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spooked by lighting and thunder, Bello and Goomo seek refuge in the Music Factory. But once inside, they realize there’s much scarier stuff afoot; there’s a ghost in the castle that’s frightening the dodos and keeping them from making music bubbles!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王不想與人分享他的新火箭驅動滑板,所以把它藏在一個魔法盒子裡。姑毛和比路決定取得它,挑戰國王的意願,最終進入一個更大的新世界。一個充滿樂趣和……危險的世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King doesn’t want to share his new rocket powered skateboard so he hides it in a magic box. Goomo and Bello decide to claim it, challenging the King’s wishes, and end up in a new and larger world. A world of fun and….danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇后心情不好。國王和孩子們同意舉辦有史以來最好的生日派對。不幸的是,每個參與者對於如何組織女王的驚喜派對都有個別非常特別的想法。它的成功將取決於他們「易地而處」的能力。尤其是女王。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen feels gloomy. The King and the children agree to organize the best birthday party ever. Unfortunately each of the participants has a very particular idea as to how to organize the Queen’s surprise party. Its success will depend on their cap

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路厭倦了女王,他認為女王試圖毀掉他所有的冒險和遊戲。在滿天流星的星夜,比路許下一個願望:願女王變回少女,讓他為所欲為。當比路的願望成真,他將必須當個瘋狂的小女王哥哥,並意識到這可能是很艱鉅的任務,有時甚至很危險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is fed up with the Queen, whom he thinks tries to ruin all his adventures and games. On a starry night, full of shooting stars, Bello makes a wish: may the Queen become a young girl again so she can let him do anything he wants. When Bello’s wi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是姑毛的生日,他有很高期望。不幸的是,他醒來發現珍愛的頭盔不見了!最重要的是,他的朋友們表現得很奇怪,他們似乎都忘記了他的生日。姑毛很樂意讓一切恢復正常。幸運的是,他收到一個驚喜,可以讓這天成為一個非常特別的日子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its Goomos birthday and his hopes are high. Unfortunately, he wakes to find his precious helmet missing! On top of that his friends are acting strangely and they all appear to have forgotten all about his birthday. Goomo would be happy to have thin

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安高在與比路和姑毛玩耍時弄傷了自己,因此必須在家休息幾天。比路感到內疚,決定搬進安高的房子,直到他的朋友好轉為止。他們對生活的不同看法相交,然後一起發現如果睜大眼睛看一切,即使是最小的細節,也可以很享受。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ongo hurt himself while playing with Bello and Goomo so he must stay at home to rest for several days. Bello feels guilty and decides to move into Ongo’s house until his friend feels better. Their different views on life will meet and together they’l

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔在米娜的實驗室試做自己的實驗。她很快就發現首先需要學習一些基礎知識來避免災難發生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita tries her own experiments in Mina’s lab. She’ll soon discover she first needs to learn some basics in order to avoid a disaster.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about winged wonders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路發現他最好的朋友有音樂天賦。從那一刻起,他將嘗試與其他朋友分享發現。儘管姑毛很害羞,比路還是會嘗試揭露和分享這個秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛弄丟了他用來和比路玩啫堡俠和頭盔仔的眼鏡。他們都發現一隻戴著姑毛眼鏡的瞎子渡渡鳥。戴上它後,渡渡鳥可以重見光明,並與其他渡渡鳥玩耍。姑毛會放棄他的眼鏡,還是取回它去當超級英雄?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has lost the glasses he uses to play Jammboman and Helmetkid with Bello. Both friends discover a blind Dodo wearing Goomo’s glasses. With them on, the Dodo can actually see and play with the rest of the Dodos. Will Goomo give up his glasses or

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和公主正在舉行一場可愛的粉紅色野餐:粉紅色的菜餚、粉紅色的食物、粉紅色的一切!莉塔向公主傾訴她希望啫堡上的所有東西都是她最喜歡的顏色。她衝到音樂工廠,將五顏六色的音樂泡泡變成粉紅色,這可能會讓一切變得一樣!當其他孩子意識到莉塔的行動時,他們必須在啫堡變成一片大而無聊、貧瘠的粉紅色荒地前,努力恢復
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored mus

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛和莉塔正在戶外度過愉快的一天,突然發現一顆渡渡鳥蛋。孩子們和小雞蛋將進行動作連場的冒險。經過這麼多的喧囂,鳥蛋能存活下來嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 音盤已經瘋了,啫堡中的所有聲音都被改變,造成了巨大的混亂。比路和莉塔將負責將每一個聲音歸還到它所屬的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路必須戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮喪。幸運的是,他的朋友們用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何問題都可以變成有趣的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛決定穿上一雙神奇的運動鞋走10萬步,這將帶他找到一個神奇的寶藏。至少他堅信如此,而他的朋友們則認為他瘋了。最後,誰會贏?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has decided to take 100.000 steps with a pair of magic sneakers that will lead him to an amazing treasure. At least that’s what he believes because his friends think he’s gone crazy. In the end, who wins?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工需要甚麼?我們可以用日常物品創造出哪些驚人的發明?米娜有答案。她很快就會向她的朋友們證明科學不一定無聊。事實上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳資源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does a special agent need? What amazing inventions can we create with our everyday objects? Mina has the answer. She´ll soon prove to her friends that science doesnt need to be boring. In fact it can be a secret agents´ best resource.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們參加捉伊人比賽,看誰是宇宙中最強隊伍。那麼,這有甚麼問題呢?即使他們不在比賽時,也開始將其他隊員視為敵人。必須有人教他們競爭和敵對的分別。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get wound up in a tag-playing competition to see who the best team in the universe is. So, what´s wrong with that? They begin to see the other team members as enemies even when they´re not playing. Someone will have to teach them the dif

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王迫不及待地想試用他的新品:一個會隨著音樂飛舞的浴缸。當國王暫時離開時,比路和米娜最終成為第一個嘗試的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King is impatient to try out his new acquisition: a bathtub that flies to music. When the King steps away momentarily, Bello and Mina end up being the first to try it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路突然擁有了強大的力量,這要歸功於一枚滿足他所有願望的警長星章。他的新責任賦予了他如此多的力量,令比路最終希望得到很快就會後悔的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello suddenly has great powers thanks to a sheriff star badge that grants his every wish. His new responsibility empowers him so much that Bello ends up wishing for something he´ll soon regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王傷了背部。每個人都想出一個計劃,把他安然無恙地送回城堡裡舒適的床上。他們必須學會傾聽對方的意見,甚至考慮最荒謬的選擇,因為你永遠不知道答案在哪裡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has hurt his back. Everyone thinks of a plan to transport him –safe and sound – to his comfortable bed back in the castle. They must learn to listen to each other and consider even the most absurd options because you never know where the ans

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛必須擔任舞蹈比賽的評委。起初,這個決定似乎很容易,但當他發現選擇贏家就意味著選擇輸家時……事情變得複雜!他會失去他淘汰的朋友嗎?那樣重的責任會令他感覺怎樣?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has to judge a dance contest. At first, the decision seems easy but when he discovers that choosing a winner means choosing a loser... It gets complicated! Will he lose the friend he signals out as the loser? How does so much responsibility mak

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是孩子們相聚並畫畫的好日子,他們都興奮地開始。比路知道他的畫是女王的最愛,他迫不及待地想給她看他最新的作品。不幸的是,女王正忙著教莉塔一些東西。比路認為這不公平。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a wonderful day to draw and the children gather round, exited to get started. Bello knows his drawings are the Queens favorite and he cant wait to show her his latest one. Unfortunately, the Queen is too busy trying to teach Rita something. Be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白色渡渡鳥突然造訪孩子們。他們所有人,尤其是安高,都與這種不可思議的動物交上了朋友。不幸的是,白色渡渡鳥有一個任務在身,分別似乎無可避免。儘管悲傷地告別,但總有音樂讓他們振作起來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get a surprise visit from a White Dodo. All of them, especially Ongo, make friends with this incredible animal. Unfortunately, the White Dodo has a mission to accomplish and a separation seems inevitable. Despite the sad goodbye, there i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜讀完智者伊朵羅的傳記後,驚訝萬分。對她來說,沒有甚麼比智慧更重要。這就是為何她會避免發問,以免暴露她的無知。令她吃驚的是,有些事情其他人都知道,除了她自己。很快她就會明白不恥下問的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina is in awe after reading Yidoro The Wises biography. For her, there is nothing more important than wisdom.Thats why she will avoid asking questions that would reveal her ignorance. To her surprise there are things that everyone else knows, exce

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #5
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎土豚和變色龍來到節目。牠們都有長舌,用於進食、打理和防衛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome an Aardvark and Chameleon to the show. These animals both have very long tongues that are used for eating, grooming and protection.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #6
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎大象和獵犬來到節目。牠們都努力保持涼爽!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome an Elephant and a Hunting Dog to the show. Each of these animals works hard to stay cool!

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #7
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎斑馬和獅子來到節目。牠們有共同的棲息地:非洲草原。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Zebra and a Lion to the show. These animals share a habitat: the African Grasslands.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #8
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎響尾蛇和超特殊客人史汀奇自己!牠們都因其防禦機制而在整個動物界享負盛名。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Rattlesnake and extra special guest Stinky! Both animals are known throughout the animal kingdom for their defense mechanisms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一些球員開始發脾氣,一場椰子沙灘足球比賽變得緊張起來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A game of coconut beach soccer becomes stressful when some of the players start throwing tantrums.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利希望他有寶拉和阿添那樣的表兄弟姊妹。小孩們幫尋找他的表兄弟姊妹。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy wishes he had cousins like Paula and Tim has. The children help to find his cousins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利設法說服寶拉和其他人將探險家先生從尷尬的困境中解救出來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy manages to convince Paula and the others to save Mr Explorer from a sticky situation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅鬍子船長摧毀了小孩們的沙堡。如何應對像紅鬍子這樣的惡霸呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Redbeard destroys the childrens sandcastles. How to deal with a bully like Redbeard?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場誤會惹怒了紅鬍子船長,他做了一些刻薄的事來報復小孩們。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A misunderstanding angers Captain Redbeard and he does something mean to get back at the children.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅鬍子船長不斷對莫里斯頤指氣使。他甚至命令莫里斯要快樂。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Redbeard is constantly ordering Maurice around. He even orders Maurice to be happy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探險家先生俘虜了圖騰頭先生!寶拉和她的朋友們將如何拯救圖騰頭先生?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Explorer has captured Mr Totemhead! What will Paula and her friends do to save Mr Totemhead?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們去叢林探險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children go for an adventure through the Jungle.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #19
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #19
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這裡有松鼠,那裡有松鼠,到處都有松鼠!少年遊俠必須阻止松鼠入侵薩利鄰近的社區花園。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers must stop a squirrel invasion at Zari’s neighbourhood community garden.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #20
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #20
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 里奧和姬蒂把他們的小工具借給薩利,但卻被一群頑皮的猴子截劫。在沒有任何小工具幫助他們完成任務的情況下,遊俠將如何奪回他們的小工具呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leo and Katie loan out their gadgets to Zari, but they get stolen by a bunch of mischievous monkeys.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠薩利意外地在膠杯中發現了一隻獨特的昆蟲,他呼召遊俠團協助這隻可憐的生物安全回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Zari calls for the Rangers in helping a unique insect get back to safety.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉偶然發現一雙被困在井裡的母獅和她的幼獅。在遊俠的幫助下,他們需要想方設法來幫牠們擺脫困境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farah stumbles upon a trapped lioness and her cub inside a well.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉發現一顆未知的動物牙齒,並尋求遊俠團協助將其歸還給真正的主人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farah finds an unknown animal tooth and seeks the Rangers assistance in returning it to its rightful owner.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪遇到一隻正在掙扎的被困海豚!他尋求少年遊俠團協助海豚重獲自由。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kyle comes across a struggling trapped dolphin!

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利和法拉築篝火過夜時偶遇一隻馬來亞幼虎,於是呼召少年遊俠團助牠與母親團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stumbling a Malayan Tiger cub during their campfire sleepover.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱憐憫受傷的螃蟹,他呼召少年遊俠團幫助這隻可憐的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai calls for the Junior Rangers in helping the injured crab.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場意外令凱的無人機墜入海床。他知道一頭不知名的怪物劫持了那墜落的無人機後,就呼召少年遊俠團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai calls up the Junior Ranger as he learns a obscure monster is taken his fallen drone as hostage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利發現一隻可能瀕臨絕種的黃胸織布鳥,這讓少年遊俠團們警戒起來,迅速動員採取行動,決心保護這鳥類免受傷害。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers determined to safeguard the Baya Weaver bird from harm.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #9
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪並不知道與斧頭鯊共泳有多險象橫生,少年遊俠團隊用新升級的車輛極速去營救嘉豪。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers rush their way to rescue Kyle from hammerhead sharks with their newly upgraded vehicle.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dragon, Squirt and Bounce learn about the rewards of helping others when Miss Spider does a good deed for Spiderus and asks him to ‘pass it on’ in return./ Wiggle teaches everybuggy in Sunny Patch that sometimes, to get things done, brains are better

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小麻、盤絲和雪兒跟一隻獨立的小亞洲瓢蟲成為朋友,發現她的獨立是有原因的:她的家人在冬眠後飛走了,卻不小心把她獨留下來。/秋天到了,迷路的小瓢蟲季絲確信家人會回到陽光派。但事與願違,史汀奇和韋飛建議收留她- 直至她不需要為止。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Shimmer, Pansy and Snowdrop befriend an independent little Asian ladybug it turns out she is independent for a reason./ It’s fall and Grace, the little lost ladybug, is sure her family is coming back to Sunny Patch.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和公主正在舉行一場可愛的粉紅色野餐:粉紅色的菜餚、粉紅色的食物、粉紅色的一切!莉塔向公主傾訴她希望啫堡上的所有東西都是她最喜歡的顏色。她衝到音樂工廠,將五顏六色的音樂泡泡變成粉紅色,這可能會讓一切變得一樣!當其他孩子意識到莉塔的行動時,他們必須在啫堡變成一片大而無聊、貧瘠的粉紅色荒地前,努力恢復
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored mus

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛和莉塔正在戶外度過愉快的一天,突然發現一顆渡渡鳥蛋。孩子們和小雞蛋將進行動作連場的冒險。經過這麼多的喧囂,鳥蛋能存活下來嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 音盤已經瘋了,啫堡中的所有聲音都被改變,造成了巨大的混亂。比路和莉塔將負責將每一個聲音歸還到它所屬的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路必須戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮喪。幸運的是,他的朋友們用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何問題都可以變成有趣的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛決定穿上一雙神奇的運動鞋走10萬步,這將帶他找到一個神奇的寶藏。至少他堅信如此,而他的朋友們則認為他瘋了。最後,誰會贏?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has decided to take 100.000 steps with a pair of magic sneakers that will lead him to an amazing treasure. At least that’s what he believes because his friends think he’s gone crazy. In the end, who wins?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工需要甚麼?我們可以用日常物品創造出哪些驚人的發明?米娜有答案。她很快就會向她的朋友們證明科學不一定無聊。事實上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳資源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does a special agent need? What amazing inventions can we create with our everyday objects? Mina has the answer. She´ll soon prove to her friends that science doesnt need to be boring. In fact it can be a secret agents´ best resource.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們參加捉伊人比賽,看誰是宇宙中最強隊伍。那麼,這有甚麼問題呢?即使他們不在比賽時,也開始將其他隊員視為敵人。必須有人教他們競爭和敵對的分別。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get wound up in a tag-playing competition to see who the best team in the universe is. So, what´s wrong with that? They begin to see the other team members as enemies even when they´re not playing. Someone will have to teach them the dif

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王迫不及待地想試用他的新品:一個會隨著音樂飛舞的浴缸。當國王暫時離開時,比路和米娜最終成為第一個嘗試的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King is impatient to try out his new acquisition: a bathtub that flies to music. When the King steps away momentarily, Bello and Mina end up being the first to try it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路突然擁有了強大的力量,這要歸功於一枚滿足他所有願望的警長星章。他的新責任賦予了他如此多的力量,令比路最終希望得到很快就會後悔的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello suddenly has great powers thanks to a sheriff star badge that grants his every wish. His new responsibility empowers him so much that Bello ends up wishing for something he´ll soon regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王傷了背部。每個人都想出一個計劃,把他安然無恙地送回城堡裡舒適的床上。他們必須學會傾聽對方的意見,甚至考慮最荒謬的選擇,因為你永遠不知道答案在哪裡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has hurt his back. Everyone thinks of a plan to transport him –safe and sound – to his comfortable bed back in the castle. They must learn to listen to each other and consider even the most absurd options because you never know where the ans

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛必須擔任舞蹈比賽的評委。起初,這個決定似乎很容易,但當他發現選擇贏家就意味著選擇輸家時……事情變得複雜!他會失去他淘汰的朋友嗎?那樣重的責任會令他感覺怎樣?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has to judge a dance contest. At first, the decision seems easy but when he discovers that choosing a winner means choosing a loser... It gets complicated! Will he lose the friend he signals out as the loser? How does so much responsibility mak

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是孩子們相聚並畫畫的好日子,他們都興奮地開始。比路知道他的畫是女王的最愛,他迫不及待地想給她看他最新的作品。不幸的是,女王正忙著教莉塔一些東西。比路認為這不公平。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a wonderful day to draw and the children gather round, exited to get started. Bello knows his drawings are the Queens favorite and he cant wait to show her his latest one. Unfortunately, the Queen is too busy trying to teach Rita something. Be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白色渡渡鳥突然造訪孩子們。他們所有人,尤其是安高,都與這種不可思議的動物交上了朋友。不幸的是,白色渡渡鳥有一個任務在身,分別似乎無可避免。儘管悲傷地告別,但總有音樂讓他們振作起來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get a surprise visit from a White Dodo. All of them, especially Ongo, make friends with this incredible animal. Unfortunately, the White Dodo has a mission to accomplish and a separation seems inevitable. Despite the sad goodbye, there i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜讀完智者伊朵羅的傳記後,驚訝萬分。對她來說,沒有甚麼比智慧更重要。這就是為何她會避免發問,以免暴露她的無知。令她吃驚的是,有些事情其他人都知道,除了她自己。很快她就會明白不恥下問的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina is in awe after reading Yidoro The Wises biography. For her, there is nothing more important than wisdom.Thats why she will avoid asking questions that would reveal her ignorance. To her surprise there are things that everyone else knows, exce

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蜘蛛小姐對蛛華士行善並只要求牠「傳開去」作為回報,小龍、史角和蹦士瞭解到助蟲的回報。/ 韋高教育陽光派所有蟲子,有時候要成事,腦力比勞力更重要。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dragon, Squirt and Bounce learn about the rewards of helping others when Miss Spider does a good deed for Spiderus and asks him to ‘pass it on’ in return./ Wiggle teaches everybuggy in Sunny Patch that sometimes, to get things done, brains are better

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小麻、盤絲和雪兒跟一隻獨立的小亞洲瓢蟲成為朋友,發現她的獨立是有原因的:她的家人在冬眠後飛走了,卻不小心把她獨留下來。/秋天到了,迷路的小瓢蟲季絲確信家人會回到陽光派。但事與願違,史汀奇和韋飛建議收留她- 直至她不需要為止。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Shimmer, Pansy and Snowdrop befriend an independent little Asian ladybug it turns out she is independent for a reason./ It’s fall and Grace, the little lost ladybug, is sure her family is coming back to Sunny Patch.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #19
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #19
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這裡有松鼠,那裡有松鼠,到處都有松鼠!少年遊俠必須阻止松鼠入侵薩利鄰近的社區花園。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers must stop a squirrel invasion at Zari’s neighbourhood community garden.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #20
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #20
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 里奧和姬蒂把他們的小工具借給薩利,但卻被一群頑皮的猴子截劫。在沒有任何小工具幫助他們完成任務的情況下,遊俠將如何奪回他們的小工具呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leo and Katie loan out their gadgets to Zari, but they get stolen by a bunch of mischievous monkeys.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠薩利意外地在膠杯中發現了一隻獨特的昆蟲,他呼召遊俠團協助這隻可憐的生物安全回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Zari calls for the Rangers in helping a unique insect get back to safety.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉偶然發現一雙被困在井裡的母獅和她的幼獅。在遊俠的幫助下,他們需要想方設法來幫牠們擺脫困境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farah stumbles upon a trapped lioness and her cub inside a well.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉發現一顆未知的動物牙齒,並尋求遊俠團協助將其歸還給真正的主人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farah finds an unknown animal tooth and seeks the Rangers assistance in returning it to its rightful owner.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪遇到一隻正在掙扎的被困海豚!他尋求少年遊俠團協助海豚重獲自由。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kyle comes across a struggling trapped dolphin!

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利和法拉築篝火過夜時偶遇一隻馬來亞幼虎,於是呼召少年遊俠團助牠與母親團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stumbling a Malayan Tiger cub during their campfire sleepover.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱憐憫受傷的螃蟹,他呼召少年遊俠團幫助這隻可憐的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai calls for the Junior Rangers in helping the injured crab.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #7

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai calls up the Junior Ranger as he learns a obscure monster is taken his fallen drone as hostage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利發現一隻可能瀕臨絕種的黃胸織布鳥,這讓少年遊俠團們警戒起來,迅速動員採取行動,決心保護這鳥類免受傷害。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers determined to safeguard the Baya Weaver bird from harm.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #9
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪並不知道與斧頭鯊共泳有多險象橫生,少年遊俠團隊用新升級的車輛極速去營救嘉豪。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers rush their way to rescue Kyle from hammerhead sharks with their newly upgraded vehicle.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #5
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎土豚和變色龍來到節目。牠們都有長舌,用於進食、打理和防衛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome an Aardvark and Chameleon to the show. These animals both have very long tongues that are used for eating, grooming and protection.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #6
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎大象和獵犬來到節目。牠們都努力保持涼爽!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome an Elephant and a Hunting Dog to the show. Each of these animals works hard to stay cool!

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #7
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎斑馬和獅子來到節目。牠們有共同的棲息地:非洲草原。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Zebra and a Lion to the show. These animals share a habitat: the African Grasslands.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #8
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎響尾蛇和超特殊客人史汀奇自己!牠們都因其防禦機制而在整個動物界享負盛名。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Rattlesnake and extra special guest Stinky! Both animals are known throughout the animal kingdom for their defense mechanisms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路發現他最好的朋友有音樂天賦。從那一刻起,他將嘗試與其他朋友分享發現。儘管姑毛很害羞,比路還是會嘗試揭露和分享這個秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #10
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱的無人機測試發現了一個大熊貓的爪印,促使少年遊俠團開展研究熊貓及其小寶寶的任務。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kais drone test leads to a discovery of a giant panda paw print.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #11
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利知悉貘及其寶寶出乎意料地遭老虎狩獵,立即呼召少年遊俠團。老虎的騷擾讓貘寶寶在森林裡迷路。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari calls for the Junior Rangers after learning a Tapir and its child are being hunted.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #12
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪發現椰子蟹將椰子從樹頂掉下來,少年遊俠團協助他清理海灘,使它變得更安全。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers assist Kyle in cleaning up the beach and make it safer after discovering a coconut crab.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #13
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 平靜的早晨被一隻可愛小貓的求助打斷了。法拉呼召少年遊俠團協助牠與母親團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A calm morning is interrupted by a cute kitten, calling the help.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #14
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪發現一隻奇怪的受傷動物被鎖在籠裡,就呼召少年遊俠團協助這隻可憐的動物安全回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai discover a strange injured animal locked in a cage and calls on the help of the Junior Ranger.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #15
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利害怕在晚上遇到未知生物,她呼召少年遊俠團助她瞭解更多這種神秘的懸掛動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari calls the Junior Rangers in helping her learning more of the mysterious hanging animal.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Orang has the worlds noisiest bedroom. Inside, its time to go to sleep -- but outside, its time for an amazing animal to make some very strange noises. Can you help Baby O discover whos making such a terrible racket?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛弄丟了他用來和比路玩啫堡俠和頭盔仔的眼鏡。他們都發現一隻戴著姑毛眼鏡的瞎子渡渡鳥。戴上它後,渡渡鳥可以重見光明,並與其他渡渡鳥玩耍。姑毛會放棄他的眼鏡,還是取回它去當超級英雄?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has lost the glasses he uses to play Jammboman and Helmetkid with Bello. Both friends discover a blind Dodo wearing Goomo’s glasses. With them on, the Dodo can actually see and play with the rest of the Dodos. Will Goomo give up his glasses or

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和公主正在舉行一場可愛的粉紅色野餐:粉紅色的菜餚、粉紅色的食物、粉紅色的一切!莉塔向公主傾訴她希望啫堡上的所有東西都是她最喜歡的顏色。她衝到音樂工廠,將五顏六色的音樂泡泡變成粉紅色,這可能會讓一切變得一樣!當其他孩子意識到莉塔的行動時,他們必須在啫堡變成一片大而無聊、貧瘠的粉紅色荒地前,努力恢復
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored mus

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛和莉塔正在戶外度過愉快的一天,突然發現一顆渡渡鳥蛋。孩子們和小雞蛋將進行動作連場的冒險。經過這麼多的喧囂,鳥蛋能存活下來嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kais drone test leads to a discovery of a giant panda paw print.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #11
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利知悉貘及其寶寶出乎意料地遭老虎狩獵,立即呼召少年遊俠團。老虎的騷擾讓貘寶寶在森林裡迷路。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari calls for the Junior Rangers after learning a Tapir and its child are being hunted.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers assist Kyle in cleaning up the beach and make it safer after discovering a coconut crab.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #13

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A calm morning is interrupted by a cute kitten, calling the help.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #14

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai discover a strange injured animal locked in a cage and calls on the help of the Junior Ranger.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路必須戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮喪。幸運的是,他的朋友們用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何問題都可以變成有趣的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛決定穿上一雙神奇的運動鞋走10萬步,這將帶他找到一個神奇的寶藏。至少他堅信如此,而他的朋友們則認為他瘋了。最後,誰會贏?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has decided to take 100.000 steps with a pair of magic sneakers that will lead him to an amazing treasure. At least that’s what he believes because his friends think he’s gone crazy. In the end, who wins?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工需要甚麼?我們可以用日常物品創造出哪些驚人的發明?米娜有答案。她很快就會向她的朋友們證明科學不一定無聊。事實上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳資源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does a special agent need? What amazing inventions can we create with our everyday objects? Mina has the answer. She´ll soon prove to her friends that science doesnt need to be boring. In fact it can be a secret agents´ best resource.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #16
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉坐著她的越野電單車穿梭於山林中,從而遇到一隻可憐的臺灣小黑熊。她因擔心而找少年遊俠團協助牠跟媽媽團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Driving her dirt bike on the mountainous forest, Farah encounters a poor moon bear cub.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #17
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱的無人機新升級帶領少年遊俠團執行營救雪豹的任務。他們前往尼泊爾山區,在英雄的幫助下拯救雪豹。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kais new drone upgrade leads the Junior Rangers on a mission to rescue a snow leopard.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #18
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利發現一條奇怪的魚從水裡蠕動出來。然後她呼召少年遊俠團協助牠回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari discovers a strange fish as it squirming out of the water.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #19
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱的煙霧彈實驗讓他遇到一隻日本大鯢。然後他知悉牠被困岩石間,因此他向少年遊俠團尋求幫助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kais smoke bombs experiments lead him to encountering a Giant Japanese Salamander.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #20
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠嘉豪在南印度的雨林偶遇一隻會飛的蜥蜴。他請求里奧和姬蒂幫他更瞭解這種獨特的生物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Junior Ranger Kyle stumbles upon a flying lizard in the South Indian rainforest.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #21

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari and the Junior Rangers unite to reunite an adorable baby elephant with its mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是中國以及您在那裡發現的奇妙獨特的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about China and the marvellous unique animals that you find there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是動物進食的不同方式。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the different ways that animals eat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集我們將看看所有那些看起來很可愛但絕對不可愛的大型美麗動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode we’re taking a look at all those big beautiful animals that look cute but definitely not cuddly.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的都是動物,它們是我們最好的朋友、我們的幫手、我們的同伴和我們的夥伴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about animals that are our best friends our helpers our companions and our sidekicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於驚人動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about astounding animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於動物牙齒的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about teeth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於動物晚餐的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about what animals eat for dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於卵生動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about eggs and what hatches from them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與洛奇和朋友們一起釋放他們的藝術才能,為我們畫一些非常酷的恐龍,它們有長長的脖子、巨大的翅膀、華麗的角和鋒利的爪子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Rocky and friends as they unleash their artistic ability and draw us some very cool dinosaurs!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與洛奇和朋友們一起釋放他們的藝術才能,為我們畫一些非常酷的恐龍,它們有長長的脖子、巨大的翅膀、華麗的角和鋒利的爪子。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Can you guess what animal hes sculpting today?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 曲奇用她的雪條棍製作的卡祖笛吹出悅耳的音樂,並為她的玩具貓製作了一艘神奇的火箭飛船。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kooki makes sweet music with her popsicle stick kazoo and makes a fantastic rocket ship for her toy kitty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《小毛孩大百科》能解答小孩們一直喜愛的動物的疑問。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMooPedia answers the questions kids have always wanted to know about their favourite animals

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盧賓浩了解到在玩了一整天後喝水很重要。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lubinho learns that it is important to drink water after playing all day.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘿! 這是您最喜歡的動物吟遊詩人團體!這是 ZooMoo 樂團! 加入我們的 ZooMoo 朋友們,他們會為我們唱一首關於海狸的輕快曲調!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its the ZooMoo Band! Join our ZooMoo friends as they sing us a toe-tapping tune all about beavers!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當其他人都得到讚揚和掌聲時,要站著面對並不總是那麼容易。比路嘗試在他朋友的表演中搶盡風頭,讓他們非常沮喪,比路需要分享他的一些才能來解決問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It´s not always easy to stand still when everyone else gets praise and applause. Bello will try to steal the show during his friends performances. They get so upset that Bello will need to share some of his talent to fix things.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路和姑毛發現城堡裡的所有玩具都放在一個盒子裡,他們面對著一項幾乎不可能完成的任務。雖然誘惑很大,但他們接到嚴格的命令,不能碰盒子,因為他們肯定會弄得一團糟。他們能服從命令,讓城堡一塵不染嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello andy Goomo are faced with an almost impossible task when they discover that all the toys in the castle have been placed in a single box. The temptation is great but they have strict orders not to touch the box for they would surely make a huge

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 還有比在音樂誕生的星球更適合跳舞的地方嗎?啫堡上的每個人都會向您展示一段舞蹈,這樣我們就可以隨著啫堡的節奏一起跳舞。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Is there a better place to dance than the planet where music is born? Every person on Jammbo has a dance to show you so we can all dance together to the rhythm of Jammbo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 成為啫堡之王並非易事。嗯……是容易的。但國王認為應該更容易,所以他創造了自己的複製人,他能指揮他們在四處做所有艱苦的工作。不出所料,這些複製人就像國王一樣非常懶惰,不但沒有提供幫助,反而成為了啫堡一個日益嚴重的新問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being the King of Jammbo isnt an easy task. Well...yes it is. But the King believes it should even more easy, so he creates clones of himself that he can order around, having them do all the hard work. As expected, these clones, much like the King,a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡舉行了另一場有趣的比賽,每個孩子必須在渡渡鳥的幫助下,力所能及找到最大的音樂三葉草。比路遇到要協助他的渡渡鳥時感到吃虧。因牠是比路見過最老、最愛發牢騷的渡渡鳥。不過,比路很快就意識到,這隻特殊的渡渡鳥和他們之間的特殊關係,會帶來比他想像中多的驚喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Another fun contest in Jammbo is celebrated, in which each child, with the help of a Dodo, must search for the largest musical clover he can find.Bello feels at a disadvantage when he meets the Dodo who will assist him. This Dodo is the oldest and th

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王剛剛調整了他的汽車,所以想讓所有人都見到。這就是為何他組織了一場賽車比賽,啫堡上的所有車輛都將參加!甚至連莉塔和她的三輪車也參賽!比賽開始,國王不再自負,這說服孩子們需要聯合起來,全力以赴贏得勝利!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has just tuned his car and hes not willing for it to go unnoticed.Thats why hes organized a race in which all vehicles on Jammbo will compete! Even Rita with her tricycle! The race begins and the King sets his cockiness free, thus convinc

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛的舊運動鞋終於破了,女王送給他一雙閃亮的新鞋。姑毛對新運動鞋那令人著迷的潔白感到非常驚訝,令他做不到任何事。問題是……如果你不能穿著波鞋跑過泥濘或用它們踢球,還要它來幹嘛?姑毛是這麼想的。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Goomos old sneakers finally break, the Queen gives him a new, shiny pair. Goomo is so taken back with the hypnotic whiteness of his new sneakers, that he is incapable of anything else. The question is...is it worth having sneakers if you cant

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和王后在神秘的「幻變森林」中散步時,發現了一隻離家出走的小渡渡鳥,在這個陌生地方迷了路。在救援行動中,莉塔也迷路了。她需要運用自己的聰敏才能找到小渡渡鳥,並回到朋友身邊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and the Queen take a walk thru the mysterious “changing forest” when they discovera baby Dodo who has strayed away from its parents and is lost in this strange place. During the rescue operation, Rita gets lost as well. She will need to apply he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜的一項實驗刺激到一隻渡渡蝶,使其長得非常巨大。一開始,牠嚇跑了啫堡上所有人,但渡渡蝶和孩子們很快就會經歷一段美好而意想不到的友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of Minas experiments provokes a Dodo-Butterfly to grow at mammoth proportions. At the beginning, the animal scares away the people on Jammbo but the Dodo-Butterfly and the children, will soon experience a beautiful and unexpected friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔有很多優點,但卻沒有耐性。這就是為何她無法等到床邊故事時間閱讀女王守衛著的書的下一章。她將與比路合作,瘋狂地搶書,並儘快知道故事的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita has a lot of good qualities but patience is not one of them. Thats why shes incappable of waiting until bedtime to read the next chapter of a book the Queen is guarding. The kid will join forces with Bello in a crazy attempt to get the book, a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜因為莉塔失去了她的房子,所以米娜邀請她的朋友來她家一起住。這種新體驗一開始看起來很有趣,最終卻將成為一個真正的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina losses her house because of Rita, so the little one invites her friend to her house to live with her. This new experience, that seemed so fun at the beginning, will end up being a real challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對女王來說,國王已經變得太依賴渡渡鳥。國王被逼證明他確實是有能力統治的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its become obvious to Queen that the King has become too dependent on the Dodos.A King should be more self-sufficient! So when the Queen expresses her doubts, King is forced to prove that he is, indeed, someone capable of reigning.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是啫堡一個昏暗落雨的下午!孩子們因為不能出去而很難過,所以國王提議一個有趣的活動:輪流講故事。他們將共同創作一個令他們驚喜的故事,甚至將牠們變成……怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a dark and rainy afternoon in Jammbo. The kids are sad because they cant go out, so the King proposes a fun activity: Telling a story taking turns. All toghether, theyll create a story that will surprise them and even transform them into ... m

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路驚訝地聽到國王說施比受更為有福。這怎麼可能?比路竭盡全力證明這一理論。不幸的是,他的嘗試不適用於姑毛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is very surprised when he hears the King saying that its better to give gifts than to receive them. How can that be possible? Bello will do his best to prove that theory. Unfortunately his attempts will not turn out right for Goomo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 誰說你不能一心二用?比路會嘗試證明這是可能的,並會在慶祝生日的同時嘗試照顧國王。他會成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Who says you cant do two things at the same time? Bello will try to prove that such a thing is possible and will try to take care of the King while celebrating a birthday. Will he succeed?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拍檔俠意識到對啫堡俠來說,他只不過是一個小助手。這令拍檔俠重新考慮他的忠誠度,並採用一種新的可怕人格。他將成為……宿敵!他會打敗啫堡俠嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sidekick-Man realizes that to Jammbo-Man he is nothing but a petty assistant. That will makeSidekick-Man reconsider his loyalties and adopt a new and terrible personality. He will become ... the archenemy! Will he defeat Jammbo-Man?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔有很多優點,但卻沒有耐性。這就是為何她無法等到床邊故事時間閱讀女王守衛著的書的下一章。她將與比路合作,瘋狂地搶書,並儘快知道故事的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita has a lot of good qualities but patience is not one of them. Thats why shes incappable of waiting until bedtime to read the next chapter of a book the Queen is guarding. The kid will join forces with Bello in a crazy attempt to get the book, a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜因為莉塔失去了她的房子,所以米娜邀請她的朋友來她家一起住。這種新體驗一開始看起來很有趣,最終卻將成為一個真正的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina losses her house because of Rita, so the little one invites her friend to her house to live with her. This new experience, that seemed so fun at the beginning, will end up being a real challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對女王來說,國王已經變得太依賴渡渡鳥。國王被逼證明他確實是有能力統治的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its become obvious to Queen that the King has become too dependent on the Dodos.A King should be more self-sufficient! So when the Queen expresses her doubts, King is forced to prove that he is, indeed, someone capable of reigning.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是啫堡一個昏暗落雨的下午!孩子們因為不能出去而很難過,所以國王提議一個有趣的活動:輪流講故事。他們將共同創作一個令他們驚喜的故事,甚至將牠們變成……怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a dark and rainy afternoon in Jammbo. The kids are sad because they cant go out, so the King proposes a fun activity: Telling a story taking turns. All toghether, theyll create a story that will surprise them and even transform them into ... m

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路驚訝地聽到國王說施比受更為有福。這怎麼可能?比路竭盡全力證明這一理論。不幸的是,他的嘗試不適用於姑毛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is very surprised when he hears the King saying that its better to give gifts than to receive them. How can that be possible? Bello will do his best to prove that theory. Unfortunately his attempts will not turn out right for Goomo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 誰說你不能一心二用?比路會嘗試證明這是可能的,並會在慶祝生日的同時嘗試照顧國王。他會成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Who says you cant do two things at the same time? Bello will try to prove that such a thing is possible and will try to take care of the King while celebrating a birthday. Will he succeed?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拍檔俠意識到對啫堡俠來說,他只不過是一個小助手。這令拍檔俠重新考慮他的忠誠度,並採用一種新的可怕人格。他將成為……宿敵!他會打敗啫堡俠嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sidekick-Man realizes that to Jammbo-Man he is nothing but a petty assistant. That will makeSidekick-Man reconsider his loyalties and adopt a new and terrible personality. He will become ... the archenemy! Will he defeat Jammbo-Man?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the different ways that animals eat.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode we’re taking a look at all those big beautiful animals that look cute but definitely not cuddly.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的都是動物,它們是我們最好的朋友、我們的幫手、我們的同伴和我們的夥伴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about animals that are our best friends our helpers our companions and our sidekicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about astounding animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about teeth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於動物晚餐的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about what animals eat for dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於卵生動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about eggs and what hatches from them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路和姑毛夢想成為真正的超級英雄,所以他們請米娜訓練他們。她恰如其分,只是比路還沒有準備好忍受漫長而艱苦的訓練。他放棄並選擇了一項更容易的活動。那是他以後會後悔的事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello and Goomo dream of becoming real super heroes so they ask Mina to train them.She sets out to do a great jobbut Bello isnt ready to endure the long and hard training. He gives up and choses an easier activity. Something he will later regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當其他人都得到讚揚和掌聲時,要站著面對並不總是那麼容易。比路嘗試在他朋友的表演中搶盡風頭,讓他們非常沮喪,比路需要分享他的一些才能來解決問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It´s not always easy to stand still when everyone else gets praise and applause. Bello will try to steal the show during his friends performances. They get so upset that Bello will need to share some of his talent to fix things.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路和姑毛發現城堡裡的所有玩具都放在一個盒子裡,他們面對著一項幾乎不可能完成的任務。雖然誘惑很大,但他們接到嚴格的命令,不能碰盒子,因為他們肯定會弄得一團糟。他們能服從命令,讓城堡一塵不染嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello andy Goomo are faced with an almost impossible task when they discover that all the toys in the castle have been placed in a single box. The temptation is great but they have strict orders not to touch the box for they would surely make a huge

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 還有比在音樂誕生的星球更適合跳舞的地方嗎?啫堡上的每個人都會向您展示一段舞蹈,這樣我們就可以隨著啫堡的節奏一起跳舞。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Is there a better place to dance than the planet where music is born? Every person on Jammbo has a dance to show you so we can all dance together to the rhythm of Jammbo.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #34
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠凱發現一條被困的大比目魚被沖上岸。在少年遊俠團的幫助下,他們執行營救任務,把這隻大型生物送回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kyle discovers a large trapped flat fish washed up on shore.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #35
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱發現了一條有奇怪外觀的魚,而一群海鷗過來騷擾牠時,他向少年遊俠團尋求求助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai discovers a weird looking fish and asks the Junior Rangers help.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #36
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利的泥灘探索發現了翻倒的圓尾鱟。少年遊俠能克服恐懼,幫助這些螃蟹華麗轉身嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zaris mudflat exploration leads to the discovery of overturned Mangrove Horseshoe Crabs.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #37
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉在東南亞海床的探索發現一隻海蜘蛛,促使里奧、姬蒂和英雄的任務是將其從強流中救出來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farahs exploration of the Southeast Asian seabed leads to the discovery of a sea spider.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #38
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠團阻止無人機小隊騷擾澳洲可愛的短尾矮袋鼠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers stops a drone squad from harrasing the cute lovable Quokka in Australia.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #39
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠凱與岸邊擱淺的一頭藍鯨幼崽成為朋友,利奧、凱蒂和英雄執行救援任務,將牠帶回公海並與母親團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kyle befriends a stranded blue whale calf on the shore, prompting a rescue mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集中,我們踏上了前往大南方土地(也稱為澳洲)的旅程。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we embark on a journey to the Great Southern Land – also known as Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we look at animals that move really slowwwwww.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animal stars.
