epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在地理和生物學尺度上,人類只是霎眼間的存在罷了,但我們卻影響了許多動物的進化路徑.探索人類對狗,狼,郊狼和大象等的影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In geological and biological scales, humans have only been around for the blink of an eye, and yet weve managed to influence the evolutionary path for many animals. Explore the human impact on dogs, wolves, coyotes, elephants, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕.冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配.一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒.大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子.三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季.跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the north Atlantics intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​深入了解非洲最具標誌性但被誤解的巨型動物之一:河馬的生活.進入一場對抗賽的中心,看看一隻領土雄性河馬的咬合有多致命,然後見證它們在水下出生的奇蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look inside the life of one of Africas most iconic but misunderstood megafauna: the hippopotamus. Get in the middle of a sparring match and see just how deadly a territorial males bite can be, then witness the miracle of their underwater births.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 齊來為年輕的格鬥士們鼓掌,並親眼見證他們在美洲茂密的熱帶森林中奮力拼搏!然後退後一步,觀察一隻毒箭蛙發動絕活攻勢,還有美洲豹和凱門鱷爭奪地盤,以及見證一隻飢餓的長鼻狸與猛蜘蛛的邂逅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往美國極北地帶,拜訪沿著水道生活的終極格鬥士.春回大地,看到融雪就知道格鬥隨時上演:鷹與鷺的對決,熊族對陣,以及蜻蜓蛹與大型水蟲之間的決鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head to Americas far north for a peek at the ultimate fighters that live along its waterways. See a spring thaw kick off the competition, pitting eagles against herons, bears against bears, and dragonfly nymphs against venomous giant water bugs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴過得動盪不安,族群急忙利用早前降雨後的短暫大餐,因為隨之而來又是乾燥日子.隨著牠們的幼崽長大,覓食的壓力變得比之前更大.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The pressure to find food reaches new heights and throws the reserve into turmoil. Witness fractures emerge within the ranks, dividing the gangs and leading Crystal, the indomitable leader of the Ruins gang, to face a challenge like none before.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探小熊們在夏季如何學習爬樹和覓食,為重返野外生活做好準備.迎接一批新成員驚喜入營,見證熊寶貝們進入冬眠前的大吃特吃,並享受一場盛大的小熊感恩祭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spy on the summer cubs as they learn to climb trees and forage for food in preparation for their release into the wild. Get surprised by a set of new arrivals, observe the annual pre-hibernation eating binge, and enjoy a bear-friendly Thanksgiving.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕.冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配.一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒.大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子.三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季.跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the north Atlantics intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在歐洲,喀爾巴阡山脈的偏遠荒野是由古老森林和陡峭峽谷組成的一片戲劇性土地.神秘生物在這處仍漫步野外,崎嶇的景觀是一種捕食者的家園,牠在整個歷史中刻下敬畏和恐懼:歐亞狼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the remote wilderness of the Carpathian Mountains lives an elusive predator that has inspired awe and fear throughout history: the Eurasian wolf. Discover the vital role that these once-misunderstood hunters play in protecting their ecosystem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 齊來為年輕的格鬥士們鼓掌,並親眼見證他們在美洲茂密的熱帶森林中奮力拼搏!然後退後一步,觀察一隻毒箭蛙發動絕活攻勢,還有美洲豹和凱門鱷爭奪地盤,以及見證一隻飢餓的長鼻狸與猛蜘蛛的邂逅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往美國極北地帶,拜訪沿著水道生活的終極格鬥士.春回大地,看到融雪就知道格鬥隨時上演:鷹與鷺的對決,熊族對陣,以及蜻蜓蛹與大型水蟲之間的決鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head to Americas far north for a peek at the ultimate fighters that live along its waterways. See a spring thaw kick off the competition, pitting eagles against herons, bears against bears, and dragonfly nymphs against venomous giant water bugs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物界中一些最有趣的適應性是無形的.研究這些隱藏的內部變化,以觀察不同的動物如何用驚人且看不見的方式進化並生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some of the most interesting adaptations in the animal world are completely invisible. Study these hidden, internal alterations to see how different animals have evolved to survive in amazing and unseen ways.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​了解適應性如何幫助鱷魚,這種與恐龍一樣古老的生物,進化以面對現代世界.觀看蝴蝶如何以它們的眼淚為食,然後驚嘆於它們的共同育嬰所展現的母愛奉獻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Understand how adaptability has helped the caiman, a beast as old as the dinosaurs, evolve to face the modern world. Watch butterflies feed on their tears, then marvel at the maternal devotion on display in their communal nurseries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 甲蟲已經在地球上居住了超過2.4億年.科學家們已知的甲蟲大約有38萬種,而每年都會發現數百種新品種.世上四分之一的動物是甲蟲.牠們幾乎征服了地球上每個角落和棲息地,在每次全球災難中都能倖存下來.牠們為何如此成功?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the worlds animals are beetles. They have conquer...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋因肉食性動物變得有生氣.看看在珊瑚礁巡游的鯊魚和魔鬼魚追捕牠們的獵物.瞭解有毒的魚偽裝並伏擊大意者,以及擁有甲殼的獵食者吞噬脆弱的目標.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The seas are alive with carnivores. Meet the sharks and rays who patrol the coral reefs, hunting down their prey. Learn about toxic fish who disguise themselves to ambush the unwary, and armoured predators who devour vulnerable targets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的野生海岸綿延170英里.印度和大西洋的海流匯合於此,逼使大浪湧向海岸線.這裡也是駐莫桑比克的鬼蝠魟研究員安德里亞馬歇爾希望在南非境內進行首次鬼蝠魟探索的地方.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wild Coast of South Africa stretches for 170 miles. Here, the waters of the Indian and the Atlantic converge, forcing powerful waves towards the shoreline. This is where the Mozambique-based manta ray researcher Andrea Marshall hopes to conduc...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨羅傑為夏季小熊的野放做好準備,然後一起認識兩位新來的小熊--艾斯和小藍莓;牠們因嚴重的健康問題,必須在營中暫住,與新一批小熊們一起過冬.最後,一同慶祝六隻健康快樂的熊寶貝踏上全新的野外生活.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prepare for the summer cubs release with Roger, then meet Ace and Little Blueberry, two newbies with serious health issues who will have to stay over the winter with the Z cubs. Later, celebrate as six healthy, happy bears embark on their new life.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how Europes best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continents rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the waters edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​了解適應性如何幫助鱷魚,這種與恐龍一樣古老的生物,進化以面對現代世界.觀看蝴蝶如何以它們的眼淚為食,然後驚嘆於它們的共同育嬰所展現的母愛奉獻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Understand how adaptability has helped the caiman, a beast as old as the dinosaurs, evolve to face the modern world. Watch butterflies feed on their tears, then marvel at the maternal devotion on display in their communal nurseries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 甲蟲已經在地球上居住了超過2.4億年.科學家們已知的甲蟲大約有38萬種,而每年都會發現數百種新品種.世上四分之一的動物是甲蟲.牠們幾乎征服了地球上每個角落和棲息地,在每次全球災難中都能倖存下來.牠們為何如此成功?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the worlds animals are beetles. They have conquer...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋因肉食性動物變得有生氣.看看在珊瑚礁巡游的鯊魚和魔鬼魚追捕牠們的獵物.瞭解有毒的魚偽裝並伏擊大意者,以及擁有甲殼的獵食者吞噬脆弱的目標.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The seas are alive with carnivores. Meet the sharks and rays who patrol the coral reefs, hunting down their prey. Learn about toxic fish who disguise themselves to ambush the unwary, and armoured predators who devour vulnerable targets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的野生海岸綿延170英里.印度和大西洋的海流匯合於此,逼使大浪湧向海岸線.這裡也是駐莫桑比克的鬼蝠魟研究員安德里亞馬歇爾希望在南非境內進行首次鬼蝠魟探索的地方.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wild Coast of South Africa stretches for 170 miles. Here, the waters of the Indian and the Atlantic converge, forcing powerful waves towards the shoreline. This is where the Mozambique-based manta ray researcher Andrea Marshall hopes to conduc...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨羅傑為夏季小熊的野放做好準備,然後一起認識兩位新來的小熊--艾斯和小藍莓;牠們因嚴重的健康問題,必須在營中暫住,與新一批小熊們一起過冬.最後,一同慶祝六隻健康快樂的熊寶貝踏上全新的野外生活.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prepare for the summer cubs release with Roger, then meet Ace and Little Blueberry, two newbies with serious health issues who will have to stay over the winter with the Z cubs. Later, celebrate as six healthy, happy bears embark on their new life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 齊來為年輕的格鬥士們鼓掌,並親眼見證他們在美洲茂密的熱帶森林中奮力拼搏!然後退後一步,觀察一隻毒箭蛙發動絕活攻勢,還有美洲豹和凱門鱷爭奪地盤,以及見證一隻飢餓的長鼻狸與猛蜘蛛的邂逅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how Europes best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continents rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the waters edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Why do zebras have stripes? How do penguins see underwater? And why are a tree frogs eyes red? In this exploration of sight, discover how some animals have evolved to see extremely well while others have evolved to be nearly invisible.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探全球昆蟲數量銳減對地球可能造成的衝擊,揭露我們千百年來對這些微小伙伴的依賴,以及牠們在生態系統中所扮演的關鍵角色.了解人類與昆蟲之間的微妙關係如何面臨危機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熱帶雨林在墨西哥東部這個令人嘆為觀止的地區跟加勒比地區相遇.深入難以穿越的叢林,潛入神秘的水下洞穴,穿越茂密的大沼澤地,它們都庇護著墨西哥最大的捕食者- 危地馬拉鱷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive under Mexicos Yucatán rainforest into an elaborate network of flooded caves called cenotes. Learn how underground rivers feed the waterless surface on their way to the sea, supporting legions of bats, howler monkeys, and more curious species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞拉利昂戈達位於墨西哥中部的中心地帶,是一個由許多生態組成的地區.從海拔300至3000米拔地而起,從古老的半沙漠化低山開始,進入一片茂密的綠色雲霧森林,當中棲息著山貓,美洲獅和飛鼠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find surprises in Mexicos untamed Sierra Gorda biosphere. Prowl the arid semi-desert with horned lizards, marvel at axolotl regeneration in the river-fed foothills, and soar with monarch butterflies in the treetops high above a hazy cloud forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫桑比克的野生海岸線綿延1600多英里 - 當中充滿了各種海洋生物.一些世上最大的濾食器被這處營養豐富的水域所吸引.但即使這些大型生物也無法抵禦魯莽的過度捕撈.莫桑比克兩位領先的海洋研究人員安德里亞馬歇爾和娜奇亞古蘭開始尋找海洋中最隱秘的動物之一,並保護其中最知名的動物,免得為時已晚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wild coastline of Mozambique stretches along more than 1,600 miles - an area teeming with a diversity of marine life. Some of the worlds largest filter feeders are attracted to this nutrient-rich water. But even these large creatures are defe...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the regions dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熱帶雨林在墨西哥東部這個令人嘆為觀止的地區跟加勒比地區相遇.深入難以穿越的叢林,潛入神秘的水下洞穴,穿越茂密的大沼澤地,它們都庇護著墨西哥最大的捕食者- 危地馬拉鱷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive under Mexicos Yucatán rainforest into an elaborate network of flooded caves called cenotes. Learn how underground rivers feed the waterless surface on their way to the sea, supporting legions of bats, howler monkeys, and more curious species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞拉利昂戈達位於墨西哥中部的中心地帶,是一個由許多生態組成的地區.從海拔300至3000米拔地而起,從古老的半沙漠化低山開始,進入一片茂密的綠色雲霧森林,當中棲息著山貓,美洲獅和飛鼠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find surprises in Mexicos untamed Sierra Gorda biosphere. Prowl the arid semi-desert with horned lizards, marvel at axolotl regeneration in the river-fed foothills, and soar with monarch butterflies in the treetops high above a hazy cloud forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世上有多種合作形式.一些動物合作群居,而另一些動物則將群體利益置於自身的繁殖潛力之上.看看物種為了生存而進化成互相合作的眾多方式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cooperation comes in many forms. Some animals cooperate to be social while others put the welfare of the group above their own reproductive potential. See the many ways species have evolved to work with one another in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熱帶雨林在墨西哥東部這個令人嘆為觀止的地區跟加勒比地區相遇.深入難以穿越的叢林,潛入神秘的水下洞穴,穿越茂密的大沼澤地,它們都庇護著墨西哥最大的捕食者- 危地馬拉鱷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive under Mexicos Yucatán rainforest into an elaborate network of flooded caves called cenotes. Learn how underground rivers feed the waterless surface on their way to the sea, supporting legions of bats, howler monkeys, and more curious species.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find surprises in Mexicos untamed Sierra Gorda biosphere. Prowl the arid semi-desert with horned lizards, marvel at axolotl regeneration in the river-fed foothills, and soar with monarch butterflies in the treetops high above a hazy cloud forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解蜜蜂,蝴蝶與飛蛾如何讓田野和樹林充滿生機.想像如果這些勤勞的蟲蟲消失,世界會如何變樣.見證神祕的蝴蝶遷徙之旅,以及飛蛾如何巧妙地躲避飢餓的蝙蝠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moths clever way of escaping hungry bats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬堤侯連拿博士和海洋哺乳類救援隊趕著拯救被塑料套索困住的一大群海獅;一頭小水獺孤兒被一個新家庭收養.另外,在溫哥華水族館裡,一隻企鵝因一種神秘疾病而病倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the vet and his team in saving a massive sea lion caught in a plastic noose, and then visit the Rescue Center, where a harbor seal pup may lose its eyesight and a baby sea otter needs a risky but life-saving surgery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 救援隊嘗試救活一頭情況危急的海獺.馬堤博士在海上對抗惡劣的環境,以幫助被纏住的海獅.而在救援中心內,一隻頑皮的小海豹將自己置於險地,一隻瞎眼的鴨子重拾光明.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Battle wind and waves to find a sea lion trapped in a plastic ring. Then visit the rescue center, where over 80 orphan seals must be fed several times a day to prepare for release into the wild, and see an Amazonian duck get a miraculous operation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫桑比克海岸以其巨人而聞名:從每年冬季到訪的座頭鯨到常駐該處的鯨鯊.但仔細觀察就可以發現一個很少被探索的微小物種的神秘世界.雖然經常被忽視,牠們對所居住的生態系統同樣重要.在這個野生和無法預測的海岸,海洋科學家們不惜一切地保護著莫桑比克最小的生物,免得為時已晚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The coast of Mozambique is home to giants, like humpbacks and whale sharks, but the tiniest species play just as big of a role in the ecosystem. Meet the scientists who are working against the clock to protect coastal creatures big and small.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看那些突破物理,化學和工程極限的動物,牠們實現人類夢想中的能力,並找出進化如何賦予牠們如此驚人的能力.有時生存只能依靠超能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the animals that push the limits of physics, chemistry and engineering to pull off feats that humans can only dream of, and find out how evolution granted them with such amazing abilities. Sometimes it takes a super-power just to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熱帶雨林在墨西哥東部這個令人嘆為觀止的地區跟加勒比地區相遇.深入難以穿越的叢林,潛入神秘的水下洞穴,穿越茂密的大沼澤地,它們都庇護著墨西哥最大的捕食者- 危地馬拉鱷.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the seasons wax and wane and learn how trees and animals help one another survive. Witness spring fireflies dancing after dark, discover summer fungi that cool off overheated trees, and prep for autumn migrations as the leaves begin to fall.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人稱牠們為「活化石」,但這只是對倖存者的另一個稱呼.從鯊魚到鱟,這些動物的早期適應都十分成功,讓牠們數百萬年來相對地保持不變.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some call them living fossils, but thats just another way to say survivors. From the shark to the horseshoe crab, these animals early adaptations were a success, leaving them relatively unchanged for millions of years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬堤侯連拿博士和海洋哺乳類救援隊趕著拯救被塑料套索困住的一大群海獅;一頭小水獺孤兒被一個新家庭收養.另外,在溫哥華水族館裡,一隻企鵝因一種神秘疾病而病倒.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 迎戰專為殺戮而生的掠食性昆蟲,了解具有武術家身手的螳螂如何令人畏懼,然後跟隨大開殺戒的蜻蜓在半空中狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕.冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配.一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒.大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子.三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季.跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the north Atlantics intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋佔據地球的70%,是多達一百萬種已知動植物的家園.但鞏固全球最大食物網的卻是最小的海洋生物 - 浮游生物.這些微生物漂流在海洋的眾多棲息地,所到之處就會觸發覓食週期.沒有牠們,海洋中的生命將不復存在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The ocean sprawls across 70 percent of our planet and is home to as many as one million known species of plants and animals. However, it is the smallest of ocean creatures that underpins the worlds largest food web – plankton. These microscopic o...

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #3 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入人類感知以外令人眼花繚亂的世界,動物利用牠們的超感官來感測我們看不到的光,聽不到的聲音,甚至是我們無法察覺的陌生力量.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬堤侯連拿博士和海洋哺乳類救援隊趕著拯救被塑料套索困住的一大群海獅;一頭小水獺孤兒被一個新家庭收養.另外,在溫哥華水族館裡,一隻企鵝因一種神秘疾病而病倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the vet and his team in saving a massive sea lion caught in a plastic noose, and then visit the Rescue Center, where a harbor seal pup may lose its eyesight and a baby sea otter needs a risky but life-saving surgery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 救援隊嘗試救活一頭情況危急的海獺.馬堤博士在海上對抗惡劣的環境,以幫助被纏住的海獅.而在救援中心內,一隻頑皮的小海豹將自己置於險地,一隻瞎眼的鴨子重拾光明.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Battle wind and waves to find a sea lion trapped in a plastic ring. Then visit the rescue center, where over 80 orphan seals must be fed several times a day to prepare for release into the wild, and see an Amazonian duck get a miraculous operation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與我們一同踏入樹林與水源共同孕育新生命的溼地,再潛入保護年幼海狗的水下森林,拜訪一群藏身在紅樹林保護區的好奇水下古怪生物,同時你還有機會一窺真實存在的沼澤怪物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into wetlands, where trees and water meet to nurture new life. Dive into an underwater forest that protects young fur seals, visit a mangrove sanctuary where a curious band of aquatic misfits hides out, and meet some real-life swamp monsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕.冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配.一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒.大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子.三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季.跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the north Atlantics intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dr. Matt pays his weekly visit to Flamingoland, near Malton in North Yorkshire, and is called to inspect a new arrival, a male Asian Sarus Crane brought in as company to a resident female. They are an endangered species but the cranes haven't yet warmed to each other and Matt offers advice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In Birkenhead, Inspector Anthony Joynes is accompanied by the police to attend an unlocked and empty property. Inside he finds Teddy, the terrified Terrier cross that has a flea infestation so bad that he's missing half his fur. One-year-old Teddy is incredibly nervous, but will he be able to overcome his fears and allow the RSPCA to offer him help?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Fishes swim in the water. What a healing thing it would be to be able to look at the blue ocean every day if we can own an underwater world at home! Moreover, in this small ecosystem, most players are male and they even jokingly describe each other as "going underwater"; "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to appreciate the mystery of "going underwater"!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: SpongeBob's pet is Gary the Snail! Which cute pet has characteristics of both Gary and Mr. Krabs? "Cute Pet Guide" wants to introduce you to these little guys with shells on their backs - hermit crabs: as their bodies grow, they must shed their shells and move to new homes. In addition to that, there are many little-known secrets of them waiting for you to explore!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Early morning at the Brash household and Dr. Matt and his wife Clare, a horse vet, with their children enjoy a traditional English breakfast - on a traditional Dales day. They're off to the Malton Show. It's been an annual event for over a century, a chance for local people to meet and compete for prizes with their finest produce.  In a rural community, vets are crucial. Matt started as a farm vet before specialising in exotic animals. The show also gives him an opportunity to keep in touch with livestock.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. 
There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. 
White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Huang Yunong's Yunong Reptile Studio has an extraordinary passion for geckos and he regards every gecko as his own. He always feel sad when consumers buy them, just like saying goodbye to his own child. He always shares care knowledge in great detail, and cultivates concepts through his own experience to let more people know more about hem. He hopes that through "Cute Pets Coming", the overall gecko raising environment can continue to improve.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在伊斯坦堡,詹姆斯和奧利弗於加拉達塔與娜塔莉·提娜會合.他們橫渡博斯普魯斯海峽,乘坐東方快車列車穿過雪山體驗雪地摩託車,並在市場品嚐土耳其美食,果油餅(Baklava)與異國香料.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Istanbul, James and Oliver meet Natalie Tena at Galata Tower. They cross the Bosphorus, ride the Eastern Express train through snowy mountains for ski-dooing, and sample Turkish cuisine, baklava, and exotic spices at the market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄弟在坦帕的伊博爾城遇見了阿爾菲·艾倫.他們在最古老的古巴餐廳用餐,與坦帕灣閃電隊打冰球,打棒球,享用在地海鮮與啤酒,並探訪這座城市最著名的鬧鬼飯店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Phelps twins meet Alfie Allen in Tampa’s Ybor City. They eat at the oldest Cuban restaurant, play ice hockey with the Tampa Bay Lightning, play baseball, enjoy local seafood and brews, and visit the citys most haunted hotels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利聖地牙哥與熱妮西斯·羅德裡格茲會面後,詹姆斯和奧利弗參觀了青金石工作坊,體驗馬戲團,並學習了庫埃卡舞(Cueca).他們還遊覽了壯麗的葡萄園,品嚐頂級葡萄酒,並親手製作傳統恩潘納達餅(Empanadas).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Genesis Rodriguez in Santiago, Chile, James and Oliver visit a Lapis Lazuli workshop, experience a circus, and learn the Cueca dance. They also tour stunning vineyards, sample fine wines, and cook traditional empanadas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在伊斯坦堡,詹姆斯和奧利弗於加拉達塔與娜塔莉·提娜會合.他們橫渡博斯普魯斯海峽,乘坐東方快車列車穿過雪山體驗雪地摩託車,並在市場品嚐土耳其美食,果油餅(Baklava)與異國香料.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Istanbul, James and Oliver meet Natalie Tena at Galata Tower. They cross the Bosphorus, ride the Eastern Express train through snowy mountains for ski-dooing, and sample Turkish cuisine, baklava, and exotic spices at the market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺.但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷,最貧瘠的環境中繁衍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報.動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙.牠們必須學習覓食,保護家園,吸引配偶,養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東-孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his journey discovering Chinas history through its food, Adam arrives in Shandong - birthplace of Confucius and one of the oldest and most influential culinary traditions in China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一-雲南. 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the most fascinating Chinese provinces - Yunnan. Infused with spice and fragrance from Southeast and Central Asia, people from all around China have fallen in love with this cuisine and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達炎熱的四川省和湖南省,而這次著名廚師兼作家,同時也是當地的專家導遊鄧扶霞也一併同行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives to the fiery provinces of Sichuan and Hunan and this time hes joined by celebrated chef and author Fuchsia Dunlop who is an expert on the region.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw is in Fujian - a place with a long history of migration where the movement of people left an enduring mark that manifested in its food and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往粵菜之鄉-香港和廣東,探索傳到世界各地的地區美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明的最後一站是非常特別的海南島-一個氣候宜人的熱帶島嶼,也是崇明祖先的家鄉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaws last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adams ancestral home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一種由鋼和鈦製成的獨特巨型運輸工具,有著一個特殊用途:提煉數噸黃金.這款所謂的滅菌釜是同類之最.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A unique mega transport made of steel and titanium with a special purpose: to extract tons of gold. This so-called autoclave is the biggest of its kind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這塊巨大的磁石將徹底改變世界和產能的未來.法國南部正建造目前世上最大的核融合反應堆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This giant magnet will revolutionize the world and energy production in the future. The worlds largest nuclear fusion reactor is currently under construction in southern France.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作.但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機.Playstation從此屹立不倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world’s most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅.從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智慧統治著地球和我們.人工智慧將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李奧納多·狄卡皮歐與湯姆·哈迪主演阿利安卓·崗札雷·伊納利圖執導的這部史詩級震撼巨作.故事根據真實事件改編,背景設定在美國未開墾的荒野,講述一段關於生存與背叛的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro González Iñárritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness.

epg.programme_title_tc: 李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路
epg.programme_title_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: Road To The Revenant
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路》紀錄了他從崛起新星到影壇傳奇的歷程.在突破性角色,與史柯西斯的合作以及對環保倡議的推動下,他對卓越藝術的執著追求最終讓他榮獲奧斯卡影帝殊榮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: The Road to The Revenant traces his rise from breakout star to cinema icon. Driven by bold roles, Scorsese collaborations, and eco-advocacy, his relentless pursuit of artistic excellence culminates in an epic Oscar win.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問惠妮休斯頓所演的《護花傾情》導演米克傑克遜,音樂家榮連西,《傳教士之妻》製作人艾略特雅培等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Whitney Houston’s The Bodyguard director Mick Jackson, musician Wayne Linsey, The Preacher’s Wife producer Elliot Abbott, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, nature’s most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we witness nature’s most extraordinary animal migrations, and discover the lengths they must go to, in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林在自己的家鄉多倫多展開一場迷你環球起司之旅,這座城市是世界上最多元且充滿文化魅力的地方之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes a mini cheese trip around the world in his own backyard, Toronto, one of the most diverse and cultural cities on the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的起司尋味之旅來到希臘--菲達起司的發源地,起司文化可追溯至數千年前的古老傳統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s cheese quest continues in Greece, the motherland of Feta, and where cheese culture dates back thousands of years in ancient practices.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的最後一站是風景如畫的加拿大卑詩省西岸,當地創新的起司文化由支持在地的精神所驅動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s final stop is beautiful British Columbia, Canada’s West coast, where an innovative cheese culture is driven by its 『support local』 mentality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪,歷史和個人之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉.徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adams journey to explore Chinas history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化,國際化,全球化的城市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東-孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his journey discovering Chinas history through its food, Adam arrives in Shandong - birthplace of Confucius and one of the oldest and most influential culinary traditions in China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一-雲南. 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the most fascinating Chinese provinces - Yunnan. Infused with spice and fragrance from Southeast and Central Asia, people from all around China have fallen in love with this cuisine and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達炎熱的四川省和湖南省,而這次著名廚師兼作家,同時也是當地的專家導遊鄧扶霞也一併同行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives to the fiery provinces of Sichuan and Hunan and this time hes joined by celebrated chef and author Fuchsia Dunlop who is an expert on the region.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw is in Fujian - a place with a long history of migration where the movement of people left an enduring mark that manifested in its food and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往粵菜之鄉-香港和廣東,探索傳到世界各地的地區美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在伊斯坦堡,詹姆斯和奧利弗於加拉達塔與娜塔莉·提娜會合.他們橫渡博斯普魯斯海峽,乘坐東方快車列車穿過雪山體驗雪地摩託車,並在市場品嚐土耳其美食,果油餅(Baklava)與異國香料.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Istanbul, James and Oliver meet Natalie Tena at Galata Tower. They cross the Bosphorus, ride the Eastern Express train through snowy mountains for ski-dooing, and sample Turkish cuisine, baklava, and exotic spices at the market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄弟在坦帕的伊博爾城遇見了阿爾菲·艾倫.他們在最古老的古巴餐廳用餐,與坦帕灣閃電隊打冰球,打棒球,享用在地海鮮與啤酒,並探訪這座城市最著名的鬧鬼飯店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Phelps twins meet Alfie Allen in Tampa’s Ybor City. They eat at the oldest Cuban restaurant, play ice hockey with the Tampa Bay Lightning, play baseball, enjoy local seafood and brews, and visit the citys most haunted hotels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利聖地牙哥與熱妮西斯·羅德裡格茲會面後,詹姆斯和奧利弗參觀了青金石工作坊,體驗馬戲團,並學習了庫埃卡舞(Cueca).他們還遊覽了壯麗的葡萄園,品嚐頂級葡萄酒,並親手製作傳統恩潘納達餅(Empanadas).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Genesis Rodriguez in Santiago, Chile, James and Oliver visit a Lapis Lazuli workshop, experience a circus, and learn the Cueca dance. They also tour stunning vineyards, sample fine wines, and cook traditional empanadas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 領略納米比亞千公裡的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景.一同見證超越極限的生命之美!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience Namibia’s wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖,亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. It’s a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物嬰兒:為了嬰兒免受極端情況,飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一.從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The instinct to secure a mate is one of the most powerful that there is. From the beautiful to the bizarre, this episode explores the most amazing mating rituals from right across the animal kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the world’s most toxic animals, revealing how poison and venom have given them the edge over the competition in their fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索大自然中最頑強的動物如何適應地球上一些最惡劣環境中的極端條件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how nature’s toughest animals have adapted to the extreme conditions in some of the planet’s most inhospitable environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, nature’s most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we witness nature’s most extraordinary animal migrations, and discover the lengths they must go to, in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往巴西,一群巨型發電船正處於解決當地逼切的電力需求的最後階段.它們對抗風浪,趕在限期前為200萬戶家庭提供盡可能多的電力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to Brazil where giant powerships are in the final stages of fixing the countrys desperate need for electricity. They battle winds and sea as they race to hit the deadline to send much needed power to two million homes.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信,最複雜的天文臺之一- ALMA.他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to the remote Atacama desert in Chile and to one of the most incredible and complex observatories on Earth - ALMA. He works alongside ALMAs expert team as they repair some of the worlds biggest antennas.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球疫情導致世上唯一的水底棲息地停運.米克大衛臣加入裂縫修復小組,一同潛入水中修復它,並讓美國太空總署的太空人返回內部進行訓練.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The worldwide pandemic ceased operations on the worlds only underwater habitat. Mike Davidson joins a crack repair crew as they dive in to bring it back to life and get NASA astronauts back inside for training.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺.但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷,最貧瘠的環境中繁衍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報.動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙.牠們必須學習覓食,保護家園,吸引配偶,養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往巴西,一群巨型發電船正處於解決當地逼切的電力需求的最後階段.它們對抗風浪,趕在限期前為200萬戶家庭提供盡可能多的電力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to Brazil where giant powerships are in the final stages of fixing the countrys desperate need for electricity. They battle winds and sea as they race to hit the deadline to send much needed power to two million homes.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信,最複雜的天文臺之一- ALMA.他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to the remote Atacama desert in Chile and to one of the most incredible and complex observatories on Earth - ALMA. He works alongside ALMAs expert team as they repair some of the worlds biggest antennas.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球疫情導致世上唯一的水底棲息地停運.米克大衛臣加入裂縫修復小組,一同潛入水中修復它,並讓美國太空總署的太空人返回內部進行訓練.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The worldwide pandemic ceased operations on the worlds only underwater habitat. Mike Davidson joins a crack repair crew as they dive in to bring it back to life and get NASA astronauts back inside for training.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往巴西,一群巨型發電船正處於解決當地逼切的電力需求的最後階段.它們對抗風浪,趕在限期前為200萬戶家庭提供盡可能多的電力.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索大自然中最頑強的動物如何適應地球上一些最惡劣環境中的極端條件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how nature’s toughest animals have adapted to the extreme conditions in some of the planet’s most inhospitable environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集將探索動物的溝通以及難以置信的適應能力,並揭示動物間能夠交談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore animal communication and reveal the incredible adaptations that enable animals to 『talk』 to each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 研究大自然動物中的交際花,揭示因同居而演化出的令人驚訝和難以置信的行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examining nature’s most sociable animals, unveiling the surprising and incredible behaviours that have evolved in response to cohabitation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在伊斯坦堡,詹姆斯和奧利弗於加拉達塔與娜塔莉·提娜會合.他們橫渡博斯普魯斯海峽,乘坐東方快車列車穿過雪山體驗雪地摩託車,並在市場品嚐土耳其美食,果油餅(Baklava)與異國香料.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Istanbul, James and Oliver meet Natalie Tena at Galata Tower. They cross the Bosphorus, ride the Eastern Express train through snowy mountains for ski-dooing, and sample Turkish cuisine, baklava, and exotic spices at the market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄弟在坦帕的伊博爾城遇見了阿爾菲·艾倫.他們在最古老的古巴餐廳用餐,與坦帕灣閃電隊打冰球,打棒球,享用在地海鮮與啤酒,並探訪這座城市最著名的鬧鬼飯店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Phelps twins meet Alfie Allen in Tampa’s Ybor City. They eat at the oldest Cuban restaurant, play ice hockey with the Tampa Bay Lightning, play baseball, enjoy local seafood and brews, and visit the citys most haunted hotels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利聖地牙哥與熱妮西斯·羅德裡格茲會面後,詹姆斯和奧利弗參觀了青金石工作坊,體驗馬戲團,並學習了庫埃卡舞(Cueca).他們還遊覽了壯麗的葡萄園,品嚐頂級葡萄酒,並親手製作傳統恩潘納達餅(Empanadas).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Genesis Rodriguez in Santiago, Chile, James and Oliver visit a Lapis Lazuli workshop, experience a circus, and learn the Cueca dance. They also tour stunning vineyards, sample fine wines, and cook traditional empanadas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪金凱瑞的《變相怪傑》導演漆黑羅素,《鴨子工廠》聯合主演德蘭間素,《月亮上的男人》監製米高候斯曼等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Jim Carrey’s The Mask director Chuck Russell, The Duck Factory co-star Teresa Ganzel, Man On The Moon executive producer Michael Hausman, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪雪兒《施活的遭遇》導演米高候斯曼,神尼及雪兒經理哈維克斯基,影評人柯克懇尼咳等.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Cher’s Silkwood producer Michael Hausman, Sonny  Cher manager Harvey Kresky, film critic Kirk Honeycutt, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪妮可基嫚的演技教練蘇珊伯臣,《不惜一切》監製莊拿汾塔別林,聲學導師瑪莉錫查乾等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Nicole Kidman’s acting coach Susan Batson, To Die For executive producer Jonathan Taplin, voice teacher Mary Setrakian, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 領略納米比亞千公裡的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景.一同見證超越極限的生命之美!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience Namibia’s wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖,亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. It’s a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林.這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step back in time! Explore Queensland’s ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it’s a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國土雖小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加擁有全球 5% 的物種.從山巔到海岸,親身體會守護這座豐富生命聖殿對地球是多麼至關重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earths species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美,最壯觀的亞洲遺產濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmars most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作.但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機.Playstation從此屹立不倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world’s most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一種由鋼和鈦製成的獨特巨型運輸工具,有著一個特殊用途:提煉數噸黃金.這款所謂的滅菌釜是同類之最.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A unique mega transport made of steel and titanium with a special purpose: to extract tons of gold. This so-called autoclave is the biggest of its kind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這塊巨大的磁石將徹底改變世界和產能的未來.法國南部正建造目前世上最大的核融合反應堆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This giant magnet will revolutionize the world and energy production in the future. The worlds largest nuclear fusion reactor is currently under construction in southern France.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examining nature’s most sociable animals, unveiling the surprising and incredible behaviours that have evolved in response to cohabitation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 展示大自然一些最難以置信的動物頭腦,牠們的大腦顯現出高智慧,使牠們能在競爭中取得優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Showcasing some of nature’s most incredible animal minds, whose brains demonstrate high intelligence, enabling them to gain advantage of their competition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往粵菜之鄉-香港和廣東,探索傳到世界各地的地區美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明的最後一站是非常特別的海南島-一個氣候宜人的熱帶島嶼,也是崇明祖先的家鄉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaws last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adams ancestral home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪,歷史和個人之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉.徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李奧納多·狄卡皮歐與湯姆·哈迪主演阿利安卓·崗札雷·伊納利圖執導的這部史詩級震撼巨作.故事根據真實事件改編,背景設定在美國未開墾的荒野,講述一段關於生存與背叛的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro González Iñárritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness.

epg.programme_title_tc: 李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路
epg.programme_title_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: Road To The Revenant
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路》紀錄了他從崛起新星到影壇傳奇的歷程.在突破性角色,與史柯西斯的合作以及對環保倡議的推動下,他對卓越藝術的執著追求最終讓他榮獲奧斯卡影帝殊榮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: The Road to The Revenant traces his rise from breakout star to cinema icon. Driven by bold roles, Scorsese collaborations, and eco-advocacy, his relentless pursuit of artistic excellence culminates in an epic Oscar win.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺.但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷,最貧瘠的環境中繁衍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報.動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙.牠們必須學習覓食,保護家園,吸引配偶,養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這塊巨大的磁石將徹底改變世界和產能的未來.法國南部正建造目前世上最大的核融合反應堆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This giant magnet will revolutionize the world and energy production in the future. The worlds largest nuclear fusion reactor is currently under construction in southern France.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gameplay is a feature on the history of videogames. From Pong to Pac Man, Super Mario to Lara Croft, Doom, Grand Theft Auto and beyond, we chronicle the remarkable story of the fastest evolving new media of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報.動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙.牠們必須學習覓食,保護家園,吸引配偶,養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺.但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷,最貧瘠的環境中繁衍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報.動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙.牠們必須學習覓食,保護家園,吸引配偶,養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adams journey to explore Chinas history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化,國際化,全球化的城市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東-孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his journey discovering Chinas history through its food, Adam arrives in Shandong - birthplace of Confucius and one of the oldest and most influential culinary traditions in China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一-雲南. 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the most fascinating Chinese provinces - Yunnan. Infused with spice and fragrance from Southeast and Central Asia, people from all around China have fallen in love with this cuisine and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達炎熱的四川省和湖南省,而這次著名廚師兼作家,同時也是當地的專家導遊鄧扶霞也一併同行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives to the fiery provinces of Sichuan and Hunan and this time hes joined by celebrated chef and author Fuchsia Dunlop who is an expert on the region.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw is in Fujian - a place with a long history of migration where the movement of people left an enduring mark that manifested in its food and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問茱莉亞蘿勃茲所演的《風月俏佳人》服裝設計師瑪莉蓮凡斯,《傲氣蓋天》製作人史蒂芬胡利,《好萊塢報道》的史葛芬伯格等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Julia Roberts』 Pretty Woman costume designer Marilyn Vance, Michael Collins producer Stephen Woolley, The Hollywood Reporter’s Scott Feinberg, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問湯姆漢克斯所演的《盜海狙擊》製作人丹拿般力堤,《紅粉聯盟》製作人艾略特雅培,好友兼演員佐治麥奎亞等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Tom Hanks』 Captain Phillips producer Dana Brunetti, A League Of Their Own producer Elliot Abbott, friend and actor George Maguire, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問惠妮休斯頓所演的《護花傾情》導演米克傑克遜,音樂家榮連西,《傳教士之妻》製作人艾略特雅培等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Whitney Houston’s The Bodyguard director Mick Jackson, musician Wayne Linsey, The Preacher’s Wife producer Elliot Abbott, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穆罕默德阿里是有史以來最偉大的拳擊手,至今仍是全球標誌.他的名字依舊令人尊敬.聽聽那些認識他的人,重溫他的傳奇戰鬥,並探索拳擊界最偉大象徵的一生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Muhammad Ali, the greatest fighter ever, remains a global icon. His name still commands respect. Hear from those who knew him, relive his legendary fights, and explore the life of boxing’s greatest symbol.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary chronicles the extraordinary life and career of Kylie Minogue, from her early days on the Australian soap opera Neighbours to her rise as a global music sensation.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step back in time! Explore Queensland’s ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it’s a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國土雖小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加擁有全球 5% 的物種.從山巔到海岸,親身體會守護這座豐富生命聖殿對地球是多麼至關重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earths species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美,最壯觀的亞洲遺產濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmars most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往粵菜之鄉-香港和廣東,探索傳到世界各地的地區美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明的最後一站是非常特別的海南島-一個氣候宜人的熱帶島嶼,也是崇明祖先的家鄉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaws last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adams ancestral home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點,五香牛肉炸角,泰式雞翼和燒牛扒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in plant-based French pastries, pastrami sammies, Thai chicken wings and carne asada.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作.但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機.Playstation從此屹立不倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world’s most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一種由鋼和鈦製成的獨特巨型運輸工具,有著一個特殊用途:提煉數噸黃金.這款所謂的滅菌釜是同類之最.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A unique mega transport made of steel and titanium with a special purpose: to extract tons of gold. This so-called autoclave is the biggest of its kind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這塊巨大的磁石將徹底改變世界和產能的未來.法國南部正建造目前世上最大的核融合反應堆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This giant magnet will revolutionize the world and energy production in the future. The worlds largest nuclear fusion reactor is currently under construction in southern France.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在伊斯坦堡,詹姆斯和奧利弗於加拉達塔與娜塔莉·提娜會合.他們橫渡博斯普魯斯海峽,乘坐東方快車列車穿過雪山體驗雪地摩託車,並在市場品嚐土耳其美食,果油餅(Baklava)與異國香料.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Istanbul, James and Oliver meet Natalie Tena at Galata Tower. They cross the Bosphorus, ride the Eastern Express train through snowy mountains for ski-dooing, and sample Turkish cuisine, baklava, and exotic spices at the market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄弟在坦帕的伊博爾城遇見了阿爾菲·艾倫.他們在最古老的古巴餐廳用餐,與坦帕灣閃電隊打冰球,打棒球,享用在地海鮮與啤酒,並探訪這座城市最著名的鬧鬼飯店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Phelps twins meet Alfie Allen in Tampa’s Ybor City. They eat at the oldest Cuban restaurant, play ice hockey with the Tampa Bay Lightning, play baseball, enjoy local seafood and brews, and visit the citys most haunted hotels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利聖地牙哥與熱妮西斯·羅德裡格茲會面後,詹姆斯和奧利弗參觀了青金石工作坊,體驗馬戲團,並學習了庫埃卡舞(Cueca).他們還遊覽了壯麗的葡萄園,品嚐頂級葡萄酒,並親手製作傳統恩潘納達餅(Empanadas).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Genesis Rodriguez in Santiago, Chile, James and Oliver visit a Lapis Lazuli workshop, experience a circus, and learn the Cueca dance. They also tour stunning vineyards, sample fine wines, and cook traditional empanadas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 詹姆斯和奧利弗與斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅.途經法國葡萄園與瑞士阿爾卑斯山,他們學習鐘錶製造,徵服險峻的富爾卡隘口,最終在科莫湖上以輕鬆的遊船之旅結束行程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver set off on a road trip to Lake Como with Stan Ianevski. Passing through French vineyards and the Swiss Alps, they learn watchmaking, navigate the dangerous Furka Pass, and end with a relaxing boat ride on Lake Como.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞,雙胞胎與馬修·路易斯於蓬塔阿雷納斯會合.他們徒步前往百內塔基地營,回憶《哈利波特》的拍攝點滴,跟隨當地牧民(Baqueanos)學習趕羊與騎馬,並利用夜視攝影機捕捉野生美洲獅的蹤影.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Patagonia, the twins join Matthew Lewis in Punta Arenas. They hike to Base Las Torres, reminisce about Harry Potter, learn sheep herding and horseback riding with Baqueanos, and spot a wild puma using a night-vision camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝裡斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址,走訪水洞,了解門諾會文化,巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食,飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片記錄了 Kylie Minogue 非凡的一生與事業,從她在澳洲肥皂劇《鄰居》中的早期演出,到躍升為全球音樂天后的精彩歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary chronicles the extraordinary life and career of Kylie Minogue, from her early days on the Australian soap opera Neighbours to her rise as a global music sensation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進 Cher 的世界--這位歷久不衰的傳奇人物,從平凡起步到超級巨星,她的旅程在五十多年來深刻影響了流行文化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Cher, an enduring icon whose journey from humble beginnings to superstardom has shaped pop culture for over five decades. A true pioneer, she’s dominated music charts, reinvented herself in film, and built a legacy that transce

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 布斯韋利士憑著在《虎膽龍威》中飾演尊麥堅這個標誌性角色而成為巨星,他在傳奇的演藝生涯演出過百部電影.他以魅力和幽默而聞名,但卻在2022年遭遇悲慘的挫折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruce Willis became a star with his iconic role as John McClane in Die Hard, leading to a legendary career with over 100 films. Known for his charm and humor, his career faced a tragic setback in 2022.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點,五香牛肉炸角,泰式雞翼和燒牛扒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in plant-based French pastries, pastrami sammies, Thai chicken wings and carne asada.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子,炸雞三文治和越南鯰魚;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的後院,發現美味的素壽司,開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這塊巨大的磁石將徹底改變世界和產能的未來.法國南部正建造目前世上最大的核融合反應堆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This giant magnet will revolutionize the world and energy production in the future. The worlds largest nuclear fusion reactor is currently under construction in southern France.

epg.programme_title_en: Gameplay: The Story Of The Videogame Revolution
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《電腦遊戲:電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片.歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光.從《乓》到《食鬼》,《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》,《毀滅戰士》,《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gameplay is a feature on the history of videogames. From Pong to Pac Man, Super Mario to Lara Croft, Doom, Grand Theft Auto and beyond, we chronicle the remarkable story of the fastest evolving new media of all time.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往巴西,一群巨型發電船正處於解決當地逼切的電力需求的最後階段.它們對抗風浪,趕在限期前為200萬戶家庭提供盡可能多的電力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to Brazil where giant powerships are in the final stages of fixing the countrys desperate need for electricity. They battle winds and sea as they race to hit the deadline to send much needed power to two million homes.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信,最複雜的天文臺之一- ALMA.他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to the remote Atacama desert in Chile and to one of the most incredible and complex observatories on Earth - ALMA. He works alongside ALMAs expert team as they repair some of the worlds biggest antennas.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球疫情導致世上唯一的水底棲息地停運.米克大衛臣加入裂縫修復小組,一同潛入水中修復它,並讓美國太空總署的太空人返回內部進行訓練.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The worldwide pandemic ceased operations on the worlds only underwater habitat. Mike Davidson joins a crack repair crew as they dive in to bring it back to life and get NASA astronauts back inside for training.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的重型運輸機中隊.他們致力保持CH53超級種馬直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson joins the US Marines Heavy Haulers squadron as theyre put to the test. They battle to keep their fleet of CH53 Super Stallion choppers flying, in preparation for intense warfare training exercises in the desert and mountains.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣展開一場跨國公路旅行,以幫助井井有條基金會.他們致力尋找並封鎖全美各地估計200萬個洩漏,有毒,可能致命的廢棄石油和天然氣井.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson goes on a cross-country road trip to help the Well Done Foundation. They work to find and cap some of the estimated two million leaking, toxic - potentially deadly abandoned oil and gas wells that are scattered throughout the U.S.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入世上最極端,最容易發生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鳥的團隊.他們使用鏟子,壓雪車,甚至二戰的榴彈砲,奮力保衛陡峭斜坡的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson embeds with the team of one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone mountain ski mountains in the world - Snowbird. They battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer cannon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 布斯韋利士憑著在《虎膽龍威》中飾演尊麥堅這個標誌性角色而成為巨星,他在傳奇的演藝生涯演出過百部電影.他以魅力和幽默而聞名,但卻在2022年遭遇悲慘的挫折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruce Willis became a star with his iconic role as John McClane in Die Hard, leading to a legendary career with over 100 films. Known for his charm and humor, his career faced a tragic setback in 2022.

epg.programme_title_tc: 米高 J 福克斯:演員樂觀活動家
epg.programme_title_en: Michael J. Fox: Actor, Activist, Optimist
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米高J霍士的一生,從成名到29歲被診斷出患上帕金遜症,就像一部真人秀電影,充滿了意想不到的轉折和顯著的韌性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Michael J. Foxs life, from his rise to fame to a Parkinsons diagnosis at 29, has been nothing short of a real-life movie, marked by unexpected twists and remarkable resilience.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哈裡遜福特:好萊塢英雄
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個人都認為自己熟悉夏裡遜福.他們認識富有冒險精神的反納粹考古學家和反烏託邦未來的銀翼殺手.但一旦停下攝錄機,就沒有人真正瞭解演員的真實人生了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyone thinks they know Harrison Ford. They know the adventurous Nazi-fighting archaeologist and the Blade Runner from a dystopian future. But nobody really knows the man behind the movies once the cameras have stopped rolling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Each year, hundreds of critically endangered manatees are killed in U.S. waters by boats, disease and cold weather. 2006 was the worst year on record for manatee deaths – 416 animals perished. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They’re beautiful - and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane. They’re lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific. In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: While many mainline Christian churches are in decline, Evangelical Christianity remains a powerful force in the 21st century. With 2.1 billion followers worldwide, this particular branch of faith must be doing something right. In this program, host Tevya enters the world of Evangelicals, meeting a local pastor whose weekly service is broadcast to five different locations and features a full rockband. He learns that it is all about giving back.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The White Island Volcano eruption in December 2019 claimed the lives of 23 people. Despite extraordinary stories of heroism in the rescue effort, could more have been done to prevent this awful loss of life? Terrified members of a boat trip to the New Zealand island watched on as a tower of smoke plumed from the mouth of the Volcano. It was not until they reached land that they realised the true horror of the situation. “Their skin just dripped off them like wax”, recounts a trained first-aider. Tour guide Hayden Marshall-Inman, who laid down his own life to stay behind and continue the rescue effort, is remembered fondly by his brother. “Hayden would always be the last man standing.” As time passes, grief has turned to anger. The victims' families are now building a judicial case against Royal Caribbean Cruises, claiming they did “absolutely nothing” to warn of the risks of a deadly eruption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Thousands of young people are dying from using drugs in Kachin State, Myanmar. When the government is not doing enough to crack down drugs problem, the civilians formed the anti-drugs organization called “Pat Jasan” which means “Stop and Clean the drugs” in local Kachin Language, to eradicate drugs. A clash between “Pa Jasan” groups and drugs lords occurred.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Daily routines mark time for the children of Kenya’s Nchiru AIDS orphanage. Delving into the minutiae of their burgeoning lives, it is soon clear that amid their cheerful patter, death lurks in the shadows, as they cope with the loss of parents and friends and the exhausting struggle against HIV. A beautifully composed film that quietly grips its audience with a moving exploration of coming-of-age in rural Africa and the impact of HIV/AIDS.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Thousands of young people are dying from using drugs in Kachin State, Myanmar. A clash between “Pa Jasan” groups and drugs lords occurred.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Daily routines mark time for the children of Kenya’s Nchiru AIDS orphanage. A beautifully composed film that quietly grips its audience with a moving exploration of coming-of-age in rural Africa and the impact of HIV/AIDS.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The far-right political movement known as QAnon has taken off around the world, mobilising a committed band of believers dedicated to fighting what they claim is an ‘online war’ against corrupt, child abusing elites. In the United States, the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has declared QAnon a potential domestic terrorism threat. For one family, QAnon has caused division so severe that they had to report their relative - Tim Stewart, a QAnon conspiracy theorist - to Australia's national security hotline. In a concerning twist, it emerged that Stewart has had a longstanding friendship with Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison - leading to speculation about QAnon and Australia's highest ranks of political power. A look at the alarming movement which has caused ripples through the world, through the eyes of one family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
An intimate portrait of four very different suicide bombers working for Al Nusra in Syria. From the Saudi who loves singing and fried chicken to the 26-year-­old British convert who is worried about his new wife, this remarkable film embeds with an unlikely bunch of ‘martyrdom seekers’. As each waits for their turn to go on a final mission, known by jihadists as ‘Dugma’, this film lays bare the faith and doubt at the core of men who give their life for their cause.
Winner, Golden Nymph Award for Best Documentary - Festival du Television Monte Carlo 2017

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Born in different countries yet resembling each other so much, two women walked the path of life that was surprisingly similar. A baby girl was born in a small rural village of Jura in France. Her name is Colette. Another baby was born on the outskirt of Seoul, Korea. She is Sung-mi. Colette and Sung-mi wanted to live normal lives like any other women, but they couldn't because of visions and voices from deities which they have experienced since they were very young. They thought this was their divine punishments. After meeting each other at the 2014 International Shamanism Festival in France, Colette and Sung-mi realized that their special abilities could be something meaningful: they are gifts given from God to comfort and soothe the pain of other people. Finally, Colette and Sung-mi accepted their fates as shamans and began their spiritual journey.

Colette and Sung-mi wanted to live normal lives like any other women, but they couldn't because of visions and voices from deities which they have experienced since they were very young. They thought this was their divine punishments. After meeting each other at the 2014 International Shamanism Festival in France, Colette and Sung-mi realized that their special abilities could be something meaningful: they are gifts given from God to comfort and soothe the pain of other people. Finally, Colette and Sung-mi accepted their fates as shamans and began their spiritual journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Host Tevya begins his spiritual quest by investigating Hinduism, a faith with some 900 million followers worldwide. Tevya explores Little India searching for a present for the goddess and learns a little Kathak dancing with Kritika along the way!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The far-right political movement known as QAnon has taken off around the world, mobilising a committed band of believers dedicated to fighting what they claim is an ‘online war’ against corrupt, child abusing elites. In the United States, the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has declared QAnon a potential domestic terrorism threat. For one family, QAnon has caused division so severe that they had to report their relative - Tim Stewart, a QAnon conspiracy theorist - to Australia's national security hotline. In a concerning twist, it emerged that Stewart has had a longstanding friendship with Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison - leading to speculation about QAnon and Australia's highest ranks of political power. A look at the alarming movement which has caused ripples through the world, through the eyes of one family.
